title.zh: 卷六十二 志第十五 五行一下
title.raw: 卷六十二 志第十五 五行一下 Volume 62 Treatises 15: Five Elements 1b

sentences.zh: 建隆三年春，延、寧二州雪盈尺，溝洫復冰，草木不華。

translations.literal: In spring of the third year of Jianlong, in the two prefectures of Yan and Ning snow piled a foot deep; ditches and canals froze again, and grass and trees did not bloom.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of 962, snow in Yan and Ning prefectures piled more than a foot deep; irrigation ditches froze over once more, and grass and trees failed to bloom.

sentences.zh: 丹州雪二尺。

translations.literal: In Danzhou, snow reached two chi.
translations.idiomatic: In Dan Prefecture, snow accumulated to a depth of two chi.

sentences.zh: 太平興國七年三月，宣州霜雪害桑稼。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year of Taiping Xingguo, frost and snow in Xuanzhou harmed mulberry trees and crops.
translations.idiomatic: In March 982, frost and snow in Xuan Prefecture damaged mulberry trees and field crops.

sentences.zh: 雍熙二年冬，南康軍大雨雪，江水冰，勝重載。

translations.literal: In winter of the second year of Yongxi, Nankang Army had heavy rain and snow; the river water froze and could bear heavy loads.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of 985, Nankang military prefecture saw heavy snow and rain; the river froze solid enough to bear heavily laden carts.

sentences.zh: 端拱元年閏五月，鄆州風雪傷麥。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month of the first year of Duangong, wind and snow in Yunzhou harmed wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month of 988, wind and snow in Yun Prefecture damaged the wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 淳化三年九月，京兆府大雪害苗稼。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year of Chunhua, heavy snow in the Jingzhao Prefecture harmed seedlings and crops.
translations.idiomatic: In September 992, heavy snow in Jingzhao Prefecture ruined seedlings and standing crops.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，商州大雪，民多凍死。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, heavy snow in Shangzhou caused many among the people to freeze to death.
translations.idiomatic: In February 993, heavy snow in Shang Prefecture left many commoners dead from the cold.

sentences.zh: 咸平四年三月丁丑，京師及近畿諸州雪，損桑。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou in the third month of the fourth year of Xianping, snow in the capital and nearby prefectures of the inner districts damaged mulberry trees.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the third month in 1001, snow across the capital and neighboring inner prefectures damaged mulberry plantings.

sentences.zh: 天禧元年十一月，京師大雪，苦寒，人多凍死，路有僵屍，遣中使埋之四郊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Tianxi, the capital had heavy snow and bitter cold; many people froze to death, and stiff corpses lay along the roads. Palace envoys were dispatched to bury them in the four suburban districts.
translations.idiomatic: In November 1017, heavy snow and bitter cold struck the capital; scores of people froze to death, and frozen corpses littered the roads. The court sent palace envoys to bury the dead in the four suburban precincts.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，永州大雪，六晝夜方止，江、溪魚皆凍死。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, Yongzhou had heavy snow; only after six day-and-night cycles did it cease, and fish in rivers and streams all froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of 1018, Yong Prefecture was buried in heavy snow that did not abate for six days and nights; fish in rivers and streams froze to death throughout the region.

sentences.zh: 慶曆三年十二月丁巳，大雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the twelfth month of the third year of Qingli, there was heavy rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the twelfth month in 1043, the capital region was hit by heavy snow mixed with rain.

sentences.zh: 皇祐四年十二月己丑，雪。

translations.literal: On the day jichou in the twelfth month of the fourth year of Huangyou, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the twelfth month in 1052, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 初，帝以愆亢，責躬減膳，每見輔臣，憂形於色。

translations.literal: Initially, because of drought, the Emperor blamed himself and reduced his meals; whenever he saw chief ministers, worry showed upon his face.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, troubled by drought, the emperor had blamed himself and cut back his meals; whenever he met his chief ministers, his face showed plain distress.

sentences.zh: 龐籍等因言：「臣等不能燮理陰陽，而上煩陛下責躬引咎，願守散秩以避賢路。」

translations.literal: Pang Ji and others thereupon said: "We ministers are unable to harmonize yin and yang, yet we trouble Your Majesty to blame yourself and accept fault. We wish to hold minor ranks so as to vacate the path for the worthy."
translations.idiomatic: Pang Ji and others then spoke up: "We have failed to harmonize yin and yang, yet Your Majesty has troubled yourself with self-reproach and taken the blame upon your own shoulders. We ask to accept lesser posts and clear the way for worthier ministers."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「是朕誠不能感天而惠不能及民，非卿等之過也。」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "It is that I truly cannot move Heaven and my grace cannot reach the people—it is not your fault."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "The fault lies in my own failure to move Heaven and in my inability to extend my grace to the people—it is not yours."

sentences.zh: 是夕，乃得雪。

translations.literal: That evening, snow was finally obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Snow fell that same night.

sentences.zh: 至和元年正月，京師大雪，貧弱之民凍死者甚衆。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Zhihe, the capital had heavy snow, and very many among the poor and weak among the people froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: In January 1054, heavy snow engulfed the capital, and a great many of the poor and vulnerable froze to death.

sentences.zh: 元祐二年冬，京師大雪連月，至春不止。

translations.literal: In winter of the second year of Yuanyou, the capital had heavy snow for consecutive months, continuing without cease until spring.
translations.idiomatic: During the winter of 1087, the capital saw month after month of heavy snow that continued without letup into spring.

sentences.zh: 久陰恒寒，罷上元節遊幸，降德音諸道。

translations.literal: Prolonged cloudiness and constant cold prevailed; the Lantern Festival imperial outing was cancelled, and benevolent edicts were issued to all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Under prolonged overcast skies and unrelenting cold, the Lantern Festival tour was canceled, and benevolent edicts were promulgated to every circuit.

sentences.zh: 八年十一月，京師大雪，多流民。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the eighth year, the capital had heavy snow, and there were many displaced people.
translations.idiomatic: In November 1093, heavy snow again blanketed the capital, and displaced persons filled the streets.

sentences.zh: 元符二年正月甲辰朔，御大慶殿受朝賀，以雪罷。

translations.literal: On the new moon day jiachen in the first month of the second year of Yuanfu, the Emperor was to attend at the Hall of Great Celebration to receive New Year congratulations, but it was cancelled because of snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month in 1099—the jiachen day of the new moon—the emperor was to hold New Year court in the Hall of Great Celebration, but the ceremony was canceled because of snow.

sentences.zh: 政和三年十一月，大雨雪，連十餘日不止，平地八尺餘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year of Zhenghe, heavy rain and snow continued without cease for more than ten days; on level ground the depth exceeded eight chi.
translations.idiomatic: In November 1113, heavy snow and rain fell for more than ten days without pause, burying level ground to a depth of over eight chi.

sentences.zh: 冰滑，人馬不能行，詔百官乘轎入朝。

translations.literal: The ice was slippery and people and horses could not travel; an edict ordered the hundred officials to ride sedan chairs when entering court.
translations.idiomatic: The ice was treacherously slick, and neither foot nor hoof could gain purchase; the throne ordered officials to enter court by sedan chair.

sentences.zh: 飛鳥多死。

translations.literal: Many flying birds died.
translations.idiomatic: Countless birds fell dead from the sky.

sentences.zh: 七年十二月，大雪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the seventh year, there was heavy snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of 1117, heavy snow fell.

sentences.zh: 詔收養內外乞丐老幼。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that beggars, old and young, inside and outside be taken in and supported.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered that beggars, both within the capital and without, old and young alike, be given shelter and relief.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年閏十一月，大雪，盈三尺不止。

translations.literal: In the intercalary eleventh month of the first year of Jingkang, heavy snow piled to three chi and more without ceasing.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eleventh month of 1126, snow piled higher than three chi and still would not stop.

sentences.zh: 天地晦冥，或雪未下時，陰雲中有雪絲長數寸墮地。

translations.literal: Heaven and earth were dim and dark; sometimes before snow had yet to fall, within the dark clouds there were snow threads several inches long falling to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and earth turned murky and dim; at times even before snow began to fall, strands of ice several inches long could be seen dropping from the dark clouds to earth.

sentences.zh: 二年正月丁酉，大雪，天寒甚，地冰如鏡，行者不能定立。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the first month of the second year, there was heavy snow; the heavens were extremely cold, and the ground was ice like a mirror—travelers could not stand steady.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the first month in 1127, heavy snow fell amid brutal cold; the ground was a sheet of mirror-smooth ice, and travelers could not keep their footing.

sentences.zh: 是月乙卯，車駕在青城，大雪數尺，人多凍死。

translations.literal: In this month on the day yimao, the imperial carriage was at Qingcheng; heavy snow reached several chi, and many people froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: Later that month, on the yimao day, while the imperial procession was at Qingcheng, snow piled several chi deep and many people perished from the cold.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年六月，寒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year of Jianyan, there was cold.
translations.idiomatic: In June 1129, unseasonable cold descended.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年二月寒食日，雪。

translations.literal: On the Cold Food Festival in the second month of the first year of Shaoxing, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: Snow fell on Cold Food Day in the second month of 1131.

sentences.zh: 五年二月乙巳，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the second month of the fifth year, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the second month in 1135, rain and snow fell together.

sentences.zh: 六年二月癸卯，雪。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the second month of the sixth year, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the second month in 1136, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月癸丑，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day guichou in the third month of the thirteenth year, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the third month in 1143, rain and snow mixed.

sentences.zh: 十七年二月丙申，雪。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the second month of the seventeenth year, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the second month in 1147, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 十八年二月癸卯，雪。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the second month of the eighteenth year, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the second month in 1148, snow fell again.

sentences.zh: 二十八年三月丙寅，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin in the third month of the twenty-eighth year, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the third month in 1158, rain and snow fell.

sentences.zh: 二十九年二月戊戌，大雪。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the second month of the twenty-ninth year, there was heavy snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the second month in 1159, heavy snow fell.

sentences.zh: 三十一年正月戊子，大雨雪，至於己亥，禁旅壘舍有壓者，寒甚。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the first month of the thirty-first year, heavy rain and snow fell until the day jihai; among the barracks of the palace guard there were those crushed, and the cold was extreme.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the first month in 1161, heavy snow and rain continued through the jihai day; some barracks of the palace guard collapsed under the weight, and the cold was severe.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年二月，大雪。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Qiandao, there was heavy snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of 1165, heavy snow fell.

sentences.zh: 三月，暴寒，損苗稼。

translations.literal: In the third month, sudden cold damaged seedlings and crops.
translations.idiomatic: In March of that year, a burst of freezing weather damaged seedlings and field crops.

sentences.zh: 二年春，大雨，寒，至於三月，損蠶麥。

translations.literal: In spring of the second year, heavy rain and cold lasted until the third month, damaging silkworms and wheat.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the spring of 1166, cold rains persisted into March, harming silkworms and the wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，雪。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the second month, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the second month in 1166, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 四年二月癸丑，大雪。

translations.literal: On the day guichou in the second month of the fourth year, there was heavy snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the second month in 1168, heavy snow fell.

sentences.zh: 五年二月戊子，雪。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the second month of the fifth year, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the second month in 1169, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，大風雨，寒，傷稼。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, great wind and rain and cold harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In May 1170, fierce wind and rain brought unseasonable cold that damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 七年二月丙辰，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the second month of the seventh year, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the second month in 1171, rain and snow fell together.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十二年，淮水冰，斷流。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Chunxi, the Huai River froze and its flow was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: In 1185, the Huai River froze solid and ceased to flow.

sentences.zh: 是冬，大雪。

translations.literal: That winter, there was heavy snow.
translations.idiomatic: That same winter brought heavy snow.

sentences.zh: 自十二月至明年正月，或雪，或霰，或雹，或雨水，冰冱尺余，連日不解。

translations.literal: From the twelfth month until the first month of the following year, sometimes snow, sometimes sleet, sometimes hail, sometimes rain fell; ice frozen solid exceeded a chi in thickness and for consecutive days did not thaw.
translations.idiomatic: From the twelfth month through the first month of the next year, snow, sleet, hail, and rain alternated in turn; ice more than a chi thick lay frozen for days on end without thawing.

sentences.zh: 台州雪深丈餘，凍死者甚衆。

translations.literal: In Taizhou snow was more than a zhang deep, and those who froze to death were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: In Taizhou snow piled more than a zhang deep, and a great many people froze to death.

sentences.zh: 十六年四月戊子，天水縣大雨雪，傷麥。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the fourth month of the sixteenth year, Tianshui County had heavy rain and snow that harmed wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the fourth month in 1189, heavy snow and rain in Tianshui County damaged the wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 紹熙元年三月，留寒至立夏不退。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Shaoxi, lingering cold lasted until the Start of Summer without retreating.
translations.idiomatic: In March 1190, lingering cold persisted until the Start of Summer without abating.

sentences.zh: 十二月，建甯府大雪深數尺。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Jianning Prefecture had heavy snow several chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of that year, snow in Jianning Prefecture piled several chi deep.

sentences.zh: 查源洞寇張海起，民避入山者多凍死。

translations.literal: The bandit Zhang Hai rose at Chayuan Cave; many among the people who fled into the mountains to avoid him froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: When the outlaw Zhang Hai rose up at Chayuan Cave, many civilians who took refuge in the mountains perished from the cold.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，行都大雪積冱，河冰厚尺餘，寒甚。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, the provisional capital had heavy snow piled frozen; river ice was more than a chi thick, and the cold was extreme.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of 1191, heavy snow buried the provisional capital in ice-crusted drifts; river ice grew more than a chi thick, and the cold was fierce.

sentences.zh: 是春，雷雪相繼，凍雨彌月。

translations.literal: That spring, thunder and snow followed one after another, and freezing rain lasted a full month.
translations.idiomatic: That spring thunder rolled amid successive snowfalls, and freezing rain persisted for an entire month.

sentences.zh: 四年二月己未，雪。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the second month of the fourth year, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the second month in 1193, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 慶元五年二月庚午，雪。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu in the second month of the fifth year of Qingyuan, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the second month in 1199, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 六年二月乙酉，雪。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou in the second month of the sixth year, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the second month in 1200, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 五月，亡暑，氣凜如秋。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, summer heat was absent, and the air was chill like autumn.
translations.idiomatic: In May that year, summer heat failed to come; the air felt as cold as autumn.

sentences.zh: 開禧三年二月戊申，雪。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the second month of the third year of Kaixi, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the second month in 1207, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 嘉定元年二月甲寅，雪。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the second month of the first year of Jiading, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the second month in 1208, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 四年二月丙子，雪。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi in the second month of the fourth year, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the second month in 1211, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 六年二月丁亥，雪。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the second month of the sixth year, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the second month in 1213, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 六月，亡暑，夜寒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, summer heat was absent, and nights were cold.
translations.idiomatic: In June that year, summer heat never arrived, and nights turned cold.

sentences.zh: 九年二月乙酉、丙申，雪。

translations.literal: On the days yiyou and bingchen in the second month of the ninth year, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou and bingchen days of the second month in 1216, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 十年二月庚申、壬戌，雪。

translations.literal: On the days gengshen and renxu in the second month of the tenth year, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen and renxu days of the second month in 1217, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 十七年三月癸丑，雪。

translations.literal: On the day guichou in the third month of the seventeenth year, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the third month in 1224, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 寶慶元年四月辛卯，雪。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao in the fourth month of the first year of Baoqing, there was snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the fourth month in 1225, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 紹定四年二月己巳，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day jisi in the second month of the fourth year of Shaoding, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the second month in 1231, rain and snow fell together.

sentences.zh: 六年三月壬子，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day renzi in the third month of the sixth year, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the third month in 1233, rain and snow mixed.

sentences.zh: 端平元年二月癸酉，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the second month of the first year of Duanping, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the second month in 1234, rain and snow fell.

sentences.zh: 二年三月乙未，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei in the third month of the second year, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the third month in 1235, rain and snow fell together.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙二年二月乙未，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei in the second month of the second year of Jiaxi, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the second month in 1238, rain and snow fell.

sentences.zh: 淳祐六年二月壬申，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day renshen in the second month of the sixth year of Chunyou, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the second month in 1246, rain and snow fell together.

sentences.zh: 寶祐元年二月壬子，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day renzi in the second month of the first year of Baoyou, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the second month in 1253, rain and snow mixed.

sentences.zh: 二年三月戊子，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the third month of the second year, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the third month in 1254, rain and snow fell.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，雨雪。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of 1258, rain and snow fell.

sentences.zh: 開慶元年二月庚辰，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen in the second month of the first year of Kaiqing, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the second month in 1259, rain and snow fell together.

sentences.zh: 景定五年二月辛亥，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the second month of the fifth year of Jingding, there was rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the second month in 1264, rain and snow fell.

sentences.zh: 建隆三年春，厭次縣隕霜殺桑，民不蠶。

translations.literal: In spring of the third year of Jianlong, falling frost in Yanci County killed mulberry trees, and the people did not raise silkworms.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of 962, frost in Yanci County killed the mulberry trees, and the people abandoned sericulture for the season.

sentences.zh: 淳化三年三月，商州霜，花皆死。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Chunhua, frost in Shangzhou caused all flowers to die.
translations.idiomatic: In March 992, frost in Shang Prefecture killed every flowering plant.

sentences.zh: 景德四年七月，渭州瓦亭砦早霜傷稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Jingde, early frost at Watings Stockade in Weizhou harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In July 1007, early frost at Watings Stockade in Weizhou damaged standing crops.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符九年十二月，大名、澶、相州並霜，害稼。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the ninth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Daming, Chan, and Xiang prefectures all had frost that harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In December 1016, frost struck Daming, Chan, and Xiang prefectures alike, damaging crops throughout the region.

sentences.zh: 至和二年，河東自春隕霜殺桑。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhihe, from spring in Hedong falling frost killed mulberry trees.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the spring of 1055, recurring frost in Hedong killed mulberry plantings across the region.

sentences.zh: 紹興七年二月庚申，霜殺桑稼。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the second month of the seventh year of Shaoxing, frost killed mulberry trees and crops.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十六年七月，階、成、鳳、西和州霜，殺稼幾盡。

sentences.zh: 紹熙三年九月丁未，和州隕霜連三日，殺稼。

sentences.zh: 八年十二月甲寅，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the twelfth month of the eighth year, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the twelfth month in 1181, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月辛酉夜，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the night of the day xinyou in the second month of the twelfth year, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the xinyou day of the second month in 1185, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 十三年閏月丙午，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the intercalary month of the thirteenth year, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the intercalary month in 1186, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 十五年二月丁亥，雨雪而雹。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the second month of the fifteenth year, there was rain and snow with hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the second month in 1188, rain and snow fell mixed with hail.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the sixth month, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the sixth month in 1188, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 十六年二月己卯，雹而雨。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the second month of the sixteenth year, there was hail with rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the second month in 1189, hail fell amid rain.

sentences.zh: 紹熙元年二月丙申，雪；

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the second month of the first year of Shaoxi, there was snow;
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the second month in 1190, snow fell;

sentences.zh: 丁酉，雹。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: on the dingyou day, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 二年正月戊寅，大雨雹，震雷電以雨，至二月庚辰，大雪連數日。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the first month of the second year, there was heavy hail, thunder and lightning with rain, until the day gengchen in the second month, when heavy snow continued for several days.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the first month in 1191, heavy hail fell amid thunder, lightning, and rain; heavy snow then continued for several days through the gengchen day of the second month.

sentences.zh: 是月庚寅朔，建寧府大風雨雹，僕屋殺人。

translations.literal: On the first day gengyin of that month, Jianning Prefecture had great wind, rain, and hail that toppled houses and killed people.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the first of that month in 1191, Jianning Prefecture was struck by fierce wind, rain, and hail that collapsed houses and killed people.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，大風雨雹，大如桃李實，平地盈尺，壞廬舍五千餘家，禾麻、蔬果皆損；

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, there was great wind, rain, and hail as large as peach and plum fruit, filling the level ground a foot deep, destroying more than five thousand dwellings; grain, hemp, and fruit and vegetables were all damaged;
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day in 1191, fierce wind, rain, and hailstones as large as peaches and plums piled a foot deep on level ground, destroying more than five thousand dwellings; grain, hemp, and fruit and vegetables all suffered damage;

sentences.zh: 里安縣亦如之，壞屋殺人尤甚。

translations.literal: Li'an County was likewise, and there houses were destroyed and people killed even more severely.
translations.idiomatic: Li'an County suffered the same fate, with even greater destruction of houses and loss of life.

sentences.zh: 秋，祐川縣大風雹，壞粟麥。

translations.literal: In autumn, Youchuan County had great wind and hail that destroyed millet and wheat.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, Youchuan County was struck by fierce wind and hail that destroyed millet and wheat.

sentences.zh: 慶元三年二月戊辰，雪；

translations.literal: On the day wuchen in the second month of the third year of Qingyuan, there was snow;
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the second month in 1197, snow fell;

sentences.zh: 己巳，雹。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: on the jisi day, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 四月乙丑，雨雹，大如杯，破瓦，殺燕爵。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the fourth month, there was hail as large as cups, breaking roof tiles and killing swallows and sparrows.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the fourth month in 1197, hailstones as large as cups shattered roof tiles and killed swallows and sparrows.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰元年三月丙寅，雨雹三日。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin in the third month of the first year of Jiatai, there was hail for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the third month in 1201, hail fell for three days.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou in the fifth month, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the fifth month in 1201, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 七月癸亥，大雨而雹。

translations.literal: On the day guihai in the seventh month, there was heavy rain and hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the seventh month in 1201, heavy rain fell mixed with hail.

sentences.zh: 二年四月庚寅，雨雹傷稼。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the fourth month of the second year, hail harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the fourth month in 1202, hail damaged field crops.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，大風雹而寒。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the sixth month, there was great wind and hail with cold.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the sixth month in 1202, fierce wind and hail brought unseasonable cold.

sentences.zh: 四年正月壬辰，雪而雹。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the first month of the fourth year, there was snow and hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the first month in 1204, snow fell mixed with hail.

sentences.zh: 開禧二年正月己酉，雹而雷。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou in the first month of the second year of Kaixi, there was hail and thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the first month in 1206, hail fell amid thunder.

sentences.zh: 嘉定元年閏月壬申，雨雹害稼。

translations.literal: On the day renshen in the intercalary month of the first year of Jiading, hail harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the intercalary month in 1208, hail damaged field crops.

sentences.zh: 二年三月乙未，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei in the third month of the second year, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the third month in 1209, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 六年夏，江、浙郡縣多雨雹害稼。

translations.literal: In summer of the sixth year, commanderies and counties in Jiang and Zhe had much hail that harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of 1213, many prefectures and counties in Jiang and Zhe suffered hail that damaged field crops.

sentences.zh: 十五年九月癸丑，大震雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day guichou in the ninth month of the fifteenth year, there was great thunder and hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the ninth month in 1222, violent thunder and hail struck.

sentences.zh: 十六年秋，雨雹。

translations.literal: In autumn of the sixteenth year, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of 1223, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 紹定元年五月丁酉，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the fifth month of the first year of Shaoding, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the fifth month in 1228, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 五年九月壬寅，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the ninth month of the fifth year, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the ninth month in 1232, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 六年三月丙辰，大雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the third month of the sixth year, there was heavy hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the third month in 1233, heavy hail fell.

sentences.zh: 端平二年五月乙未，雹。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei in the fifth month of the second year of Duanping, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the fifth month in 1235, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 三年六月庚戌，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu in the sixth month of the third year, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the sixth month in 1236, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙元年二月壬辰，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the second month of the first year of Jiaxi, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the second month in 1237, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 淳祐二年四月壬申，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day renshen in the fourth month of the second year of Chunyou, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the fourth month in 1242, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 八年二月壬辰，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the second month of the eighth year, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the second month in 1248, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the third month in 1248, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，雨雹。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of 1249, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 寶祐三年五月，嘉定府大雨雹。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the third year of Baoyou, Jiading Prefecture had heavy hail.
translations.idiomatic: In May 1255, heavy hail struck Jiading Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 開慶元年五月辛亥，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the fifth month of the first year of Kaiqing, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the fifth month in 1259, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 景定元年二月庚申，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the second month of the first year of Jingding, there was hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the second month in 1260, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 建隆四年四月癸巳，宿州晝日無雨，雷霆暴作，軍校傅韜震死。

translations.literal: On the day guisi in the fourth month of the fourth year of Jianlong, in Suzhou there was no rain by day, yet thunder suddenly broke out, and the military officer Fu Tao was struck dead by lightning.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the fourth month in 963, Suzhou saw a dry daytime sky suddenly erupt in thunder; the military officer Fu Tao was struck dead by lightning.

sentences.zh: 是夜夜半，雷起于京師。

translations.literal: That night at midnight, thunder arose in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That same night at midnight, thunder rolled in the capital.

sentences.zh: 開封縣署役夫劉延嗣、萬進震死，頃之復蘇，有煙焰自牖入室，因駭僕，遍體焦灼。

translations.literal: The corvee laborers Liu Yansi and Wan Jin of Kaifeng County were struck dead by lightning; shortly afterward they revived, but smoke and flame entered through the window and so terrified them that their whole bodies were scorched.
translations.idiomatic: Corvee laborers Liu Yansi and Wan Jin at Kaifeng County were struck dead by lightning; they revived shortly afterward, but smoke and flame burst through a window and so terrified them that their bodies were scorched all over.

sentences.zh: 乾德二年正月辛巳，雷起京師西南，東行有電。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi in the first month of the second year of Qiande, thunder arose in the southwest of the capital and moved eastward with lightning.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the first month in 964, thunder rolled up from the southwest of the capital and moved eastward amid lightning.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，大名府大雨，雷震焚槁聚。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the fifth month, Daming Prefecture had heavy rain; thunder and lightning set a haystack ablaze.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the fifth month in 964, heavy rain fell in Daming Prefecture; lightning set a haystack on fire.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，海州雷震長吏廳，傷刺史梁彥超。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year, Haizhou was struck by lightning in the chief administrator's hall, injuring Prefect Liang Yanchao.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 967, lightning struck the chief administrator's hall in Haizhou, injuring Prefect Liang Yanchao.

sentences.zh: 開寶七年六月，易州雷，震死耀武軍士八人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year of Kaibao, Yizhou had thunder that struck dead eight soldiers of the Yaowu Army.
translations.idiomatic: In June 974, lightning in Yi Prefecture killed eight soldiers of the Yaowu Army.

sentences.zh: 八年八月，邛州延貴鎮震死民費貴及其子四人。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eighth year, at Yanging Town in Qiongzhou, the commoner Fei Gui and his four sons were struck dead by lightning.
translations.idiomatic: In August 975, at Yanging Town in Qiong Prefecture, the commoner Fei Gui and his four sons were killed by lightning.

sentences.zh: 太平興國二年七月，景城縣震死牛商馮異。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Taiping Xingguo, the cattle merchant Feng Yi of Jingcheng County was struck dead by lightning.
translations.idiomatic: In July 977, the cattle merchant Feng Yi of Jingcheng County was killed by lightning.

sentences.zh: 端拱二年八月，興化軍民劉政震死，有文在胸曰「大不孝」。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Duangong, the commoner Liu Zheng of Xinghua Army was struck dead by lightning; on his chest there was writing that read "Great Unfiliality."
translations.idiomatic: In August 989, the commoner Liu Zheng of Xinghua military prefecture was killed by lightning; characters reading "Great Unfiliality" appeared on his chest.

sentences.zh: 淳化三年七月，泗州大風雨，震僧伽塔柱。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Chunhua, Sizhou had great wind and rain; lightning struck the pillars of the Sengqie Pagoda.
translations.idiomatic: In July 992, fierce wind and rain struck Sizhou; lightning hit the pillars of the Sengqie Pagoda.

sentences.zh: 至道元年三月甲戌，雷未發聲，召司天監寺趙昭問之，答云：「按占書，雷不發聲，寬政之應也。」

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the third month of the first year of Zhidao, before thunder had sounded, the emperor summoned Zhao Zhao of the Directorate of Astronomy and asked him; he answered: "According to prognostic texts, when thunder does not sound, it is the response of lenient government."
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the third month in 995, before thunder had yet sounded, the emperor summoned Zhao Zhao of the Directorate of Astronomy and asked him about it; he replied, "According to prognostic texts, when thunder fails to sound, it is a sign of lenient government."

sentences.zh: 七月，泗州大風雨，雷震僧伽塔及壞鐘樓。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Sizhou had great wind and rain; lightning struck the Sengqie Pagoda and destroyed the bell tower.
translations.idiomatic: In July of that year, fierce wind and rain struck Sizhou; lightning hit the Sengqie Pagoda and destroyed the bell tower.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年正月戊寅，京師西北有雷電。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the first month of the first year of Xianping, in the northwest of the capital there was thunder and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the first month in 998, thunder and lightning were heard in the northwest of the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月，瀛州、順安軍並東北有雷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Yingzhou and Shun'an Army both had thunder in the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: In November 998, thunder was heard in the northeast at Ying Prefecture and Shun'an Army.

sentences.zh: 三年冬，黃州西北雷震，似盛夏時。

translations.literal: In winter of the third year, in the northwest of Huangzhou thunder struck, like the height of summer.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of 1000, lightning flashed in the northwest of Huang Prefecture as though it were midsummer.

sentences.zh: 十二月，真定府東南雷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, in the southeast of Zhending Prefecture there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of that year, thunder was heard in the southeast of Zhending Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四年十月乙巳，京師西南雷電。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the tenth month of the fourth year, in the southwest of the capital there was thunder and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the tenth month in 1001, thunder and lightning were heard in the southwest of the capital.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月，大名府雷。

translations.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month, Daming Prefecture had thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary twelfth month of that year, thunder was heard in Daming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六年十一月甲午，京師暴雷震，司天言：「國家發號布德，未及黎庶。」

translations.literal: On the day jiawu in the eleventh month of the sixth year, the capital had violent thunder; the Directorate of Astronomy said: "The state issues commands and spreads virtue, yet these have not reached the common people."
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the eleventh month in 1003, violent thunder shook the capital; the Directorate of Astronomy said, "The state issues commands and spreads virtue, yet these have not reached the common people."

sentences.zh: 時議改元肆赦，詔宰相增廣條目，采民病悉除之。

translations.literal: At the time there was discussion of changing the reign title and granting a general amnesty; the emperor ordered the chief ministers to broaden the amnesty provisions and remove all the people's grievances.
translations.idiomatic: At the time there was discussion of changing the reign title and granting a general amnesty; the emperor ordered the chief ministers to broaden the amnesty provisions and remove every grievance afflicting the people.

sentences.zh: 景德三年九月丙寅夕，京師大震雷。

translations.literal: On the evening of the day bingyin in the ninth month of the third year of Jingde, the capital had great thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the evening of the bingyin day of the ninth month in 1006, violent thunder shook the capital.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符元年正月癸未，京師西北方雷。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei in the first month of the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, in the northwest of the capital there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the first month in 1008, thunder was heard in the northwest of the capital.

sentences.zh: 五年十二月己巳，京師西北雷電。

translations.literal: On the day jisi in the twelfth month of the fifth year, in the northwest of the capital there was thunder and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the twelfth month in 1012, thunder and lightning were heard in the northwest of the capital.

sentences.zh: 九年五月，殿侍張信奉南海祝版乘驛至唐州，震死。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year, the palace attendant Zhang Fengxin, carrying the prayer tablet for the Southern Sea by post horse to Tangzhou, was struck dead by lightning.
translations.idiomatic: In May 1016, the palace attendant Zhang Fengxin, carrying the prayer tablet for the Southern Sea by post horse to Tang Prefecture, was killed by lightning.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐四年四月丙戌，大震雷，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the fourth month of the fourth year of Jiayou, there was great thunder and hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the fourth month in 1059, violent thunder and hail struck together.

sentences.zh: 慶曆六年五月，雷雹、地震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year of Qingli, there was thunder and hail, and an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In May 1046, thunder and hail struck, and the earth quaked.

sentences.zh: 紹聖三年十月十五日，西南方有雷聲，次雨雹。

translations.literal: On the fifteenth day of the tenth month of the third year of Shaosheng, thunder was heard in the southwest, followed by hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifteenth day of the tenth month in 1096, thunder rolled from the southwest, followed by hail.

sentences.zh: 大觀三年十月戊子，大雷雹而雨。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the tenth month of the third year of Daguan, there was great thunder and hail with rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the tenth month in 1109, violent thunder and hail fell amid rain.

sentences.zh: 建炎四年正月己未，雷。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the first month of the fourth year of Jianyan, there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the first month in 1130, thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 時御舟次溫州章安鎮，高宗謂宰臣曰：「雷聲甚厲，前史以爲君弱臣強，四夷兵不制。」

translations.literal: At the time the imperial boat was at Zhang'an Town in Wenzhou; Emperor Gaozong said to the chief ministers: "The thunder was very fierce; in earlier histories this is taken to mean a weak ruler and strong ministers, and armies of the four barbarians beyond control."
translations.idiomatic: At the time the imperial boat was at Zhang'an Town in Wen Prefecture; Emperor Gaozong said to the chief ministers, "The thunder was very fierce; earlier histories take this to mean a weak ruler and strong ministers, and armies of the four barbarians beyond control."

sentences.zh: 是夕，金人破明州。

translations.literal: That evening, the Jurchens broke through Mingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That evening, the Jurchens broke through Ming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，又雷。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, there was thunder again.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, thunder sounded again.

sentences.zh: 紹興五年九月戊寅，雷。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the ninth month of the fifth year of Shaoxing, there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the ninth month in 1135, thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 十月丁巳，雷。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the tenth month, there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the tenth month in 1135, thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 六年十月丙午，雷。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the tenth month of the sixth year, there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the tenth month in 1136, thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 九年九月甲午、十月丁卯，雷。

translations.literal: On the days jiawu in the ninth month and dingmao in the tenth month of the ninth year, there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the ninth month and the dingmao day of the tenth month in 1139, thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 十一年十一月己酉，雷。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou in the eleventh month of the eleventh year, there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the eleventh month in 1141, thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 十五年十月辛卯、十二月甲寅，雷。

translations.literal: On the days xinmao in the tenth month and jiayin in the twelfth month of the fifteenth year, there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the tenth month and the jiayin day of the twelfth month in 1145, thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 十六年，溫州大雷電，震死六人于龍翔寺。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Wenzhou had great thunder and lightning that struck dead six people at Longxiang Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In 1146, violent thunder and lightning in Wen Prefecture killed six people at Longxiang Temple.

sentences.zh: 十八年閏月甲戌，雷。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the intercalary month of the eighteenth year, there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the intercalary month in 1148, thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 十九年十月甲寅，雷。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the tenth month of the nineteenth year, there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the tenth month in 1149, thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 二十一年二月辛未，南安軍大雷電，大庾縣震死四人。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei in the second month of the twenty-first year, Nan'an Army had great thunder and lightning; in Dayu County four people were struck dead.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the second month in 1151, violent thunder and lightning struck Nan'an military prefecture; in Dayu County four people were killed by lightning.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未夜，震雷。

translations.literal: On the night of the day xinwei in the eleventh month, there was thunder.

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxing it had once appeared, and afterward there was a flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: It had once appeared in 1132, after which a flood disaster followed.

sentences.zh: 蓋是歲五月，鎮果大水，皆魚孽也。

translations.literal: Indeed, in the fifth month of that year the town was struck by great flood; all were fish portents.
translations.idiomatic: Indeed, in the fifth month of that year the town was struck by great flood; all were fish portents.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十七年，海壞畿縣鹽官地數十里。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Jiading, the sea destroyed several tens of li of land in the salt-administration counties near the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In 1224, the sea destroyed several tens of li of land in the salt-administration counties near the capital.

sentences.zh: 先是，有巨魚橫海岸，民臠食之，海患共六年而平。

translations.literal: Earlier, a giant fish had lain across the coast, and the people cut its flesh to eat; the sea calamity lasted six years before it subsided.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, a giant fish had lain across the coast, and the people cut its flesh to eat; the sea calamity lasted six years before it subsided.

sentences.zh: 乾德二年四月，相州蝻蟲食桑。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Qiande, in Xiangzhou locust nymphs ate mulberry trees.
translations.idiomatic: In April 964, locust nymphs in Xiang Prefecture ate mulberry trees.

sentences.zh: 五月，昭慶縣有蝗，東西四十里，南北二十里。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, in Zhaoqing County there were locusts extending forty li east to west and twenty li north to south.
translations.idiomatic: In May of that year, locusts in Zhaoqing County covered an area forty li east to west and twenty li north to south.

sentences.zh: 是時，河北、河南、陝西諸州有蝗。

translations.literal: At that time, in the prefectures north and south of the Yellow River and in Shaanxi there were locusts.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, locusts appeared in prefectures north and south of the Yellow River and in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，諸路有蝗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, on the various routes there were locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 965, locusts appeared on various routes.

sentences.zh: 開寶二年八月，冀、磁二州蝗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Kaibao, Ji and Ci prefectures had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In August 969, Ji and Ci prefectures suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 太平興國二年閏七月，衛州蝻蟲生。

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month of the second year of Taiping Xingguo, Weizhou had locust nymphs.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month of 977, Weizhou had locust nymphs.

sentences.zh: 六年七月，河南府、宋州蝗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year, Henan Prefecture and Song Prefecture had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 981, Henan Prefecture and Song Prefecture suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 七年四月，北陽縣蝻蟲生，有飛鳥食之盡。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the seventh year, in Beiyang County locust nymphs appeared, and flying birds ate them all.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of 982, locust nymphs appeared in Beiyang County, and flying birds ate them all.

sentences.zh: 滑州蝻蟲生。

translations.literal: Huazhou had locust nymphs.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou had locust nymphs.

sentences.zh: 是月，大名府、陝州、陳州蝗。

translations.literal: In that month, Daming Prefecture, Shaan Prefecture, and Chen Prefecture had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That same month, Daming Prefecture, Shaan Prefecture, and Chen Prefecture suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 七月，陽穀縣蝻蟲生。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Yanggu County had locust nymphs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 982, Yanggu County had locust nymphs.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年七月，鄄城縣有蛾、蝗自死。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Yongxi, in Juancheng County moths and locusts died of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 986, moths and locusts in Juancheng County died of themselves.

sentences.zh: 至道二年六月，亳州、宿、密州蝗生，食苗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Zhidao, Bozhou and Suz and Mi prefectures had locusts that ate seedlings.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 996, locusts in Bozhou and Suz and Mi prefectures ate seedlings.

sentences.zh: 七月，長葛、陽翟二縣有蝻蟲食苗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, in Changge and Yangzhai counties locust nymphs ate seedlings.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of that year, locust nymphs in Changge and Yangzhai counties ate seedlings.

sentences.zh: 曆城、長清等縣有蝗。

translations.literal: In Licheng, Changqing, and other counties there were locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In Licheng, Changqing, and other counties there were locusts.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，單州蝻蟲生。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, Shanzhou had locust nymphs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 997, Shan Prefecture had locust nymphs.

sentences.zh: 景德二年六月，京東諸州蝻蟲生。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Jingde, in the eastern capital prefectures locust nymphs appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1005, locust nymphs appeared in the eastern capital prefectures.

sentences.zh: 三年八月，德、博蝝生。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year, De and Bo had locust larvae.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of 1006, De and Bo prefectures had locust larvae.

sentences.zh: 四年九月，宛丘、東阿、須城三縣蝗。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fourth year, Wansqiu, Dong'e, and Xucheng counties had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of 1007, Wansqiu, Dong'e, and Xucheng counties suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符二年五月，雄州蝻蟲食苗。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu, in Xiongzhou locust nymphs ate seedlings.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of 1009, locust nymphs in Xiong Prefecture ate seedlings.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，開封府尉氏縣蝻蟲生。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year, in Weishi County of Kaifeng Prefecture locust nymphs appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1010, locust nymphs appeared in Weishi County of Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，祥符縣蝗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year, Xiangfu County had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1011, Xiangfu County suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 七月，河南府及京東蝗生，食苗葉。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Henan Prefecture and the eastern capital had locusts that ate seedling leaves.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of that year, locusts in Henan Prefecture and the eastern capital ate seedling leaves.

sentences.zh: 八月，開封府祥符、咸平、中牟、陳留、雍丘、封丘六縣蝗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, in Xiangfu, Xianping, Zhongmou, Chenliu, Yongqiu, and Fengqiu counties of Kaifeng Prefecture there were locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of that year, locusts appeared in Xiangfu, Xianping, Zhongmou, Chenliu, Yongqiu, and Fengqiu counties of Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，京畿、京東西、河北路蝗蝻繼生，彌覆郊野，食民田殆盡，入公私廬舍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year, locusts and nymphs appeared in succession in the capital region, eastern and western capital routes, and Hebei route, spreading over the suburbs and countryside and eating the people's fields nearly to exhaustion, and entering public and private dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1016, locusts and nymphs appeared in succession throughout the capital region, the eastern and western capital routes, and the Hebei route, spreading over suburbs and countryside and devouring private fields nearly to exhaustion, and entering public and private dwellings.

sentences.zh: 七月辛亥，過京師，群飛翳空，延至江、淮南，趣河東，及霜寒始。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the seventh month, passing the capital, they flew in swarms blotting out the sky, extending to the Jiang and Huai southward, heading toward Hedong, until frost and cold began.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the seventh month, passing the capital they flew in swarms that blotted out the sky, extending southward to the Jiang and Huai and heading toward Hedong, until frost and cold set in.

sentences.zh: 斃

translations.literal: Perished.
translations.idiomatic: They perished.

sentences.zh: 天禧元年二月，開封府、京東西、河北、河東、陝西、兩浙、荊湖百三十州軍，蝗蝻復生，多去歲蟄者。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Tianxi, in Kaifeng Prefecture and in one hundred thirty prefectures and armies of the eastern and western capital routes, Hebei, Hedong, Shaanxi, the two Zhe regions, and Jing and Hu, locusts and nymphs appeared again, mostly survivors hibernating from the previous year.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of 1017, locusts and nymphs appeared again in Kaifeng Prefecture and in one hundred thirty prefectures and armies of the eastern and western capital routes, Hebei, Hedong, Shaanxi, the two Zhe regions, and Jing and Hu, mostly survivors hibernating from the previous year.

sentences.zh: 和州蝗生卵，如稻粒而細。

translations.literal: In He Prefecture locusts laid eggs like rice grains but finer.
translations.idiomatic: In He Prefecture locusts laid eggs as fine as rice grains.

sentences.zh: 六月，江、淮大風，多吹蝗入江海，或抱草木僵死。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, great wind on the Jiang and Huai blew many locusts into rivers and seas, or they clung to grass and trees and died stiff.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of that year, fierce winds on the Jiang and Huai blew many locusts into rivers and seas, or they clung to grass and trees and died stiff.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，江陰軍蝻蟲生。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year, Jiangyin Army had locust nymphs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of 1018, Jiangyin Army had locust nymphs.

sentences.zh: 天聖五年七月丙午，邢、洺州蝗。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the seventh month of the fifth year of Tiansheng, Xing and Ming prefectures had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the seventh month in 1027, Xing and Ming prefectures suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，趙州蝗。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Zhao Prefecture had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the seventh month in 1027, Zhao Prefecture suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉朔，京兆府旱蝗。

translations.literal: On the first day dingyou in the eleventh month, Jingzhao Prefecture had drought and locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the first of the eleventh month in 1027, Jingzhao Prefecture suffered drought and locusts.

sentences.zh: 六年五月乙卯，河北、京東蝗。

translations.literal: On the day yimao in the fifth month of the sixth year, Hebei and the eastern capital route had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the fifth month in 1028, Hebei and the eastern capital route suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 景祐元年六月，開封府、淄州蝗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Jingyou, Kaifeng Prefecture and Zizhou had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1034, Kaifeng Prefecture and Zi Prefecture suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 諸路募民掘蝗種萬余石。

translations.literal: On the various routes the people were recruited to dig up more than ten thousand shi of locust eggs.
translations.idiomatic: On the various routes the people were recruited to dig up more than ten thousand shi of locust eggs.

sentences.zh: 寶元二年六月癸酉，曹、濮、單三州蝗。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the sixth month of the second year of Baoyuan, Cao, Pu, and Shan prefectures had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the sixth month in 1039, Cao, Pu, and Shan prefectures suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 四年，淮南旱蝗。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Huainan had drought and locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In 1041, Huainan suffered drought and locusts.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京師飛蝗蔽天。

translations.literal: In that year, in the capital flying locusts blotted out the sky.
translations.idiomatic: That year, flying locusts in the capital blotted out the sky.

sentences.zh: 皇祐五年，建康府蝗。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Huangyou, Jiankang Prefecture had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In 1053, Jiankang Prefecture suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 元豐四年六月，河北蝗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year of Yuanfeng, Hebei had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1081, Hebei suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 秋，開封府界蝗。

translations.literal: In autumn, in the jurisdiction of Kaifeng Prefecture there were locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, locusts appeared in the jurisdiction of Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五年夏，又蝗。

translations.literal: In summer of the fifth year, locusts came again.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of 1082, locusts appeared again.

sentences.zh: 六年夏，又蝗。

translations.literal: In summer of the sixth year, locusts came again.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of 1083, locusts appeared again.

sentences.zh: 五月，沂州蝗。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Yizhou had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In May 1083, Yi Prefecture suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 元符元年八月，高郵軍蝗抱草死。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Yuanfu, in Gaoyou Army locusts clung to grass and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of 1098, locusts in Gaoyou Army clung to grass and died.

sentences.zh: 崇甯元年夏，開封府界、京東、河北、淮南等路蝗。

translations.literal: In summer of the first year of Chongning, in the jurisdiction of Kaifeng Prefecture and on the eastern capital, Hebei, and Huainan routes there were locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of 1102, locusts appeared in the jurisdiction of Kaifeng Prefecture and on the eastern capital, Hebei, and Huainan routes.

sentences.zh: 二年，諸路蝗，令有司酺祭。

translations.literal: In the second year, on the various routes there were locusts, and officials were ordered to perform exorcistic sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In 1103, locusts appeared on the various routes, and officials were ordered to perform exorcistic sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 三年、四年，連歲大蝗，其飛蔽日，來自山東及府界，河北尤甚。

translations.literal: In the third and fourth years, great locusts came in successive years; their flight blotted out the sun, coming from Shandong and the prefectural jurisdiction, with Hebei especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In 1104 and 1105, great locust swarms came in successive years; their flight blotted out the sun, coming from Shandong and the prefectural jurisdiction, with Hebei especially hard hit.

sentences.zh: 宣和三年，諸路蝗。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuanhe, on the various routes there were locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In 1121, locusts appeared on the various routes.

sentences.zh: 五年，蝗。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, there were locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In 1123, locusts appeared.

sentences.zh: 建炎二年六月，京師、淮甸大蝗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Jianyan, the capital and the Huai region had great locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1128, the capital and the Huai region suffered great locust swarms.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，令長吏修酺祭。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu in the eighth month, chief administrators were ordered to perform exorcistic sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the eighth month in 1128, chief administrators were ordered to perform exorcistic sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 紹興二十九年七月，盱眙軍、楚州金界三十里，蝗爲風所墮，風止，復飛還淮北。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-ninth year of Shaoxing, within thirty li of the Jin border at Xuyi Army and Chuzhou, locusts were blown down by the wind; when the wind stopped, they flew back north of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 1159, within thirty li of the Jin border at Xuyi Army and Chuzhou, locusts were blown down by the wind; when the wind stopped, they flew back north of the Huai.

sentences.zh: 三十二年六月，江東、淮南北郡縣蝗，飛入湖州境，聲如風雨；

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the thirty-second year, in the prefectures and counties east of the Jiang and north and south of the Huai there were locusts; they flew into Huzhou territory, their sound like wind and rain;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1162, locusts in the prefectures and counties east of the Jiang and north and south of the Huai flew into Huzhou territory, their sound like wind and rain;

sentences.zh: 自癸巳至於七月丙申，遍於畿縣，余杭、仁和、錢塘皆蝗。

translations.literal: From guisi until the day bingshen in the seventh month, they spread throughout the capital counties; Yuhang, Renhe, and Qiantang all had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: from guisi until the bingshen day of the seventh month, they spread throughout the capital counties; Yuhang, Renhe, and Qiantang all suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 丙午，蝗入京城。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, locusts entered the capital city.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, locusts entered the capital city.

sentences.zh: 八月，山東大蝗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Shandong had great locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of 1162, Shandong suffered great locust swarms.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，頒祭酺禮式。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the ritual forms for exorcistic sacrifice were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the ritual forms for exorcistic sacrifice were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年七月，大蝗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Longxing, there were great locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 1163, great locust swarms appeared.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申、癸酉，飛蝗過都，蔽天日。

translations.literal: On the days renshen and guiyou in the eighth month, flying locusts passed the capital, blotting out the sky and sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen and guiyou days of the eighth month in 1163, flying locusts passed the capital, blotting out the sky and sun.

sentences.zh: 徽、宣、湖三州及浙東郡縣，害稼。

translations.literal: In the three prefectures of Hui, Xuan, and Hu and in the prefectures and counties of eastern Zhe, crops were harmed.
translations.idiomatic: In Hui, Xuan, and Hu prefectures and in the prefectures and counties of eastern Zhe, crops were damaged.

sentences.zh: 京東大蝗，襄、隨尤甚，民爲乏食。

translations.literal: In the eastern capital there were great locusts; Xiang and Sui were especially severe, and the people suffered food shortages.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern capital region suffered great locust swarms; Xiang and Sui were especially hard hit, and the people faced food shortages.

sentences.zh: 二年夏，余杭縣蝗。

translations.literal: In summer of the second year, Yuhang County had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of 1164, Yuhang County suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年六月，淮西蝗，憲臣姚岳貢死蝗爲瑞，以佞坐黜。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Qiandao, in Huai West there were locusts; the surveillance commissioner Yao Yue presented dead locusts as an auspicious sign and was dismissed for flattery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1165, locusts appeared in western Huai; the surveillance commissioner Yao Yue presented dead locusts as an auspicious sign and was dismissed for flattery.

sentences.zh: 淳熙三年八月，淮北飛蝗入楚州、盱眙軍界，如風雷者逾時，遇大雨皆死，稼用不害。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Chunxi, flying locusts from north of the Huai entered the territory of Chuzhou and Xuyi Army, sounding like wind and thunder for more than an hour; they encountered heavy rain and all died, and the crops were not harmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of 1176, flying locusts from north of the Huai entered the territory of Chuzhou and Xuyi Army, sounding like wind and thunder for more than an hour; they encountered heavy rain and all died, and the crops were spared.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，全椒、曆陽、烏江縣蝗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year, Quanjiao, Liyang, and Wujiang counties had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1182, Quanjiao, Liyang, and Wujiang counties suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，飛蝗過都，遇大雨，墮仁和縣界。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, flying locusts passed the capital; encountering heavy rain, they fell in the territory of Renhe County.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, flying locusts passed the capital; encountering heavy rain, they fell in the territory of Renhe County.

sentences.zh: 七月，淮甸大蝗，真、揚、泰州窖撲蝗五千斛，餘郡或日捕數十車，群飛絕江，墮鎮江府，皆害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, in the Huai region there were great locusts; Zhen, Yang, and Taizhou stored five thousand hu of captured locusts, and in other prefectures some captured dozens of cartloads per day; swarms crossed the river and fell in Zhenjiang Prefecture, all harming crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 1182, the Huai region suffered great locust swarms; Zhen, Yang, and Ta prefectures stored five thousand hu of captured locusts, and in other prefectures some captured dozens of cartloads per day; swarms crossed the river and fell in Zhenjiang Prefecture, all damaging crops.

sentences.zh: 十年六月，蝗遺種於淮、浙，害稼。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the tenth year, locust eggs left on the Huai and Zhe harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1183, locust eggs left on the Huai and Zhe harmed crops.

sentences.zh: 十四年七月，仁和縣蝗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourteenth year, Renhe County had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 1187, Renhe County suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 紹熙二年七月，高郵縣蝗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Shaoxi, Gaoyou County had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 1191, Gaoyou County suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 至於泰州。

translations.literal: They reached as far as Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: They reached as far as Ta Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五年八月，楚、和州蝗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fifth year, Chu and He prefectures had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of 1194, Chu and He prefectures suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰二年，浙西諸縣大蝗，自丹陽入武進，若煙霧蔽天，其墮亙十余里，常之三縣捕八千余石，湖之長興捕數百石。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiatai, in the counties of western Zhe there were great locusts; from Danyang they entered Wujin, like smoke and mist blotting out the sky; where they fell they stretched more than ten li; in the three counties of Chang more than eight thousand shi were captured, and in Changxing of Hu several hundred shi.
translations.idiomatic: In 1202, the counties of western Zhe suffered great locust swarms; from Danyang they entered Wujin like smoke and mist blotting out the sky; where they fell they stretched more than ten li; in the three counties of Chang more than eight thousand shi were captured, and in Changxing of Hu several hundred shi.

sentences.zh: 時浙東近郡亦蝗。

translations.literal: At the time, in the nearby prefectures of eastern Zhe there were also locusts.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, nearby prefectures in eastern Zhe also suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 開禧三年，夏秋久旱，大蝗群飛蔽天，浙西豆粟皆既於蝗。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kaixi, after prolonged drought in spring and summer, great locusts flew in swarms blotting out the sky; in western Zhe beans and grain were all consumed by locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In 1207, after prolonged drought in spring and summer, great locust swarms blotted out the sky; in western Zhe beans and grain were all devoured by locusts.

sentences.zh: 紹定三年，福建蝗。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoding, Fujian had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In 1230, Fujian suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 端平元年五月，當塗縣蝗。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Duanping, Dangtu County had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In May 1234, Dangtu County suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙四年，建康府蝗。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaxi, Jiankang Prefecture had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In 1240, Jiankang Prefecture suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 淳祐二年五月，兩淮蝗。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Chunyou, the two Huai regions had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In May 1242, the two Huai regions suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 景定三年八月，兩浙蝗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Jingding, the two Zhe regions had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of 1262, the two Zhe regions suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 紹興十年春，有野豕入海州，市民刺殺之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the tenth year of Shaoxing, a wild boar entered Haizhou, and townspeople stabbed and killed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of 1140, a wild boar entered Haizhou, and townspeople stabbed and killed it.

sentences.zh: 時州已陷，夏，鎮江軍帥王勝攻取之；

translations.literal: At the time the prefecture had already fallen; in summer, the military commissioner of Zhenjiang Army, Wang Sheng, attacked and recovered it;
translations.idiomatic: At the time the prefecture had already fallen; that summer, the military commissioner of Zhenjiang Army, Wang Sheng, attacked and recovered it;

sentences.zh: 明年，以其郡屬金，悉空其民。

translations.literal: The next year, as its commandery came under Jin control, all its people were emptied out.
translations.idiomatic: the next year, as the prefecture came under Jin control, all its people were removed.

sentences.zh: 乾道六年，南雄州民家豕生數豚，首各具他獸形，有類人者。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Qiandao, at a commoner's home in Nanxiong Prefecture a sow gave birth to several piglets, each head bearing the form of another beast, some resembling humans.
translations.idiomatic: In 1170, at a commoner's home in Nanxiong Prefecture a sow gave birth to several piglets, each head bearing the form of another beast, some resembling humans.

sentences.zh: 慶元初，樂平縣民家豕生豚，與南雄同而更具他獸蹄。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qingyuan, at a commoner's home in Leping County a sow gave birth to piglets, the same as at Nanxiong but also with the hooves of other beasts.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Qingyuan era, at a commoner's home in Leping County a sow gave birth to piglets like those at Nanxiong but also with the hooves of other beasts.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，餘幹縣民家豕生八豚，其二爲鹿。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, at a commoner's home in Yugan County a sow gave birth to eight piglets, two of them deer.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of 1197, at a commoner's home in Yugan County a sow gave birth to eight piglets, two of them deer.

sentences.zh: 古田縣豕食嬰兒。

translations.literal: In Gutian County a pig ate an infant.
translations.idiomatic: In Gutian County a pig ate an infant.

sentences.zh: 淳化三年六月，黑風晝晦。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year of Chunhua, black wind darkened the day.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 992, black wind darkened the day.

sentences.zh: 景祐四年七月，黑氣長丈余，出畢宿下。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Jingyou, black qi more than one zhang long emerged below the constellation Bi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 1037, black qi more than one zhang long emerged below the constellation Bi.

sentences.zh: 康定元年，黑風晝晦。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangding, black wind darkened the day.
translations.idiomatic: In 1040, black wind darkened the day.

sentences.zh: 元豐末，嘗有物大如席，夜見寢殿上，而神宗崩。

translations.literal: At the end of Yuanfeng, there was once a thing as large as a mat that appeared at night on the sleeping hall, and Emperor Shenzong died.
translations.idiomatic: Near the end of the Yuanfeng era, a thing as large as a mat appeared at night on the sleeping hall, and Emperor Shenzong died.

sentences.zh: 元符末，又數見，而哲宗崩。

translations.literal: At the end of Yuanfu, it appeared several times again, and Emperor Zhezong died.
translations.idiomatic: Near the end of the Yuanfu era, it appeared several times again, and Emperor Zhezong died.

sentences.zh: 至大觀間，漸晝見。

translations.literal: By the Daguan period, it gradually appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: By the Daguan period, it gradually appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 政和元年以後，大作，每得人語聲則出。

translations.literal: After the first year of Zhenghe, it became very active; whenever human voices were heard, it would come out.
translations.idiomatic: After 1111, it became very active; whenever human voices were heard, it would emerge.

sentences.zh: 先若列屋摧倒之聲，其形廑丈餘，仿佛如龜，金眼，行動硜硜有聲。

translations.literal: First there would be a sound like rows of houses collapsing; its form was more than one zhang, vaguely like a turtle, with golden eyes, and as it moved it made a clanging sound.
translations.idiomatic: First there would be a sound like rows of houses collapsing; its form was more than one zhang, vaguely like a turtle, with golden eyes, and as it moved it made a clanging sound.

sentences.zh: 黑氣蒙之。

translations.literal: Black qi shrouded it.
translations.idiomatic: Black qi shrouded it.

sentences.zh: 不大了了，氣之所及，腥血四灑，兵刃皆不能施。

translations.literal: It was not clearly visible; where its qi reached, bloody stench splattered in all directions, and weapons could not be used against it.
translations.idiomatic: It was not clearly visible; where its qi reached, bloody stench splattered in all directions, and weapons could not be used against it.

sentences.zh: 又或變人形，亦或爲驢。

translations.literal: It also sometimes changed into human form, or became a donkey.
translations.idiomatic: It also sometimes changed into human form, or became a donkey.

sentences.zh: 自春曆夏，晝夜出無時，遇冬則罕見。

translations.literal: From spring through summer it came out day and night without fixed times; in winter it was rarely seen.
translations.idiomatic: From spring through summer it emerged day and night without fixed times; in winter it was rarely seen.

sentences.zh: 多在掖庭宮人所居之地，亦嘗及內殿，後習以爲常，人亦不大怖。

translations.literal: It mostly appeared in places where palace women of the inner quarters lived; it also sometimes reached the inner halls. Later people grew accustomed to it as normal, and were not greatly frightened.
translations.idiomatic: It mostly appeared where palace women of the inner quarters lived; it also sometimes reached the inner halls. Later people grew accustomed to it and were not greatly frightened.

sentences.zh: 宣和末，浸少，而亂遂作。

translations.literal: Near the end of Xuanhe it gradually diminished, and then rebellion broke out.
translations.idiomatic: Near the end of the Xuanhe era it gradually diminished, and then rebellion broke out.

sentences.zh: 政和三年夏至，宰臣何執中奉祀北郊。

translations.literal: At the summer solstice of the third year of Zhenghe, Chief Minister He Zhizhong performed the sacrifice at the northern suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: At the summer solstice of 1113, Chief Minister He Zhizhong performed the sacrifice at the northern suburban altar.

sentences.zh: 有黑氣長數丈，出自齋宮，行一里許，入壇壝，繞祭所，皆近人穿燈燭而過。

translations.literal: Black qi several zhang long emerged from the fasting palace, traveled about one li, entered the altar enclosure, circled the sacrifice site, all passing close to people and piercing through lamps and candles.
translations.idiomatic: Black qi several zhang long emerged from the fasting palace, traveled about one li, entered the altar enclosure, and circled the sacrifice site, passing close to people and piercing through lamps and candles.

sentences.zh: 俄又及於壇，禮將畢，不見。

translations.literal: Shortly it reached the altar again; when the rite was nearly complete, it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly it reached the altar again; when the rite was nearly complete, it vanished.

sentences.zh: 宣和中，洛陽府畿間，忽有物如人，或蹲踞如犬。

translations.literal: In the Xuanhe period, between the prefectures of the Luoyang region, there suddenly appeared things like humans, or crouching like dogs.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xuanhe period, between the prefectures of the Luoyang region, things like humans suddenly appeared, or crouching like dogs.
