sentences.zh: 其色正黑，不辨眉目。

translations.literal: Their color was pure black, and their brows and eyes could not be distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: They were pure black in color, and their brows and eyes could not be distinguished.

sentences.zh: 始，夜則掠小兒食之後，雖白晝，入人家爲患，所至喧然不安，謂之「黑漢」。

translations.literal: At first they preyed on small children at night; afterward, even in broad daylight they entered people's homes and caused trouble; wherever they went there was uproar and unrest. They were called the "Black Han."
translations.idiomatic: At first they preyed on small children at night; afterward, even in broad daylight they entered people's homes and caused trouble; wherever they went there was uproar and unrest. They were called the "Black Han."

sentences.zh: 有力者夜執槍棒自衛，亦有托以作過者，如此二歲乃息。

translations.literal: Strong men held spears and clubs at night for self-defense; some also used them as a pretext for wrongdoing. After two years they ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Strong men held spears and clubs at night for self-defense; some also used them as a pretext for wrongdoing. After two years they ceased.

sentences.zh: 已而北征事起，卒成金人之禍。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the northern expedition began, and in the end the calamity of the Jurchens came to pass.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the northern expedition began, and in the end the Jurchen calamity came to pass.

sentences.zh: 三年春，日有眚，忽青黑無光，其中洶洶而動，若鉟金而湧沸狀。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year, the sun had an aberration; it suddenly turned blue-black and lost its light, and within it things surged turbulently like molten metal boiling and seething.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of 1121, the sun showed an aberration; it suddenly turned blue-black and lost its light, and within it things surged turbulently like molten metal boiling and seething.

sentences.zh: 日旁有黑正如水波，周面旋繞，將暮而稍止。

translations.literal: Beside the sun there was black qi like water waves, swirling around its face; toward evening it gradually stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Beside the sun there was black qi like water waves, swirling around its face; toward evening it gradually stopped.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年二月甲寅，日初出，兩黑氣如人形，夾日旁，至巳時乃散。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the second month of the third year of Jianyan, as the sun first rose, two black vapors like human forms stood on either side of the sun, and did not disperse until the si hour.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the second month in 1129, as the sun first rose, two black vapors like human forms stood on either side of the sun, and did not disperse until mid-morning.

sentences.zh: 乾道四年春，舒州雨黑米，堅如鐵，破之，米心通黑。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year of Qiandao, Shuzhou rained black rice, hard as iron; when broken open, the rice kernel was black throughout.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of 1168, Shuzhou rained black rice, hard as iron; when broken open, the rice kernel was black throughout.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十一年二月。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eleventh year of Chunxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of 1184.

sentences.zh: 臨安府新城縣深浦天雨黑水終夕。

translations.literal: At Shenpu in Xincheng County of Lin'an Prefecture, black water rained all night.
translations.idiomatic: At Shenpu in Xincheng County of Lin'an Prefecture, black water rained all night.

sentences.zh: 十六年六月，行都錢塘門啟，黑風入，揚沙石。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixteenth year, when the Qiantang Gate of the traveling capital opened, black wind entered and whipped up sand and stones.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1189, when the Qiantang Gate of the traveling capital opened, black wind entered and whipped up sand and stones.

sentences.zh: 慶元元年，徽州黃山民家古井，風雨夜出黑氣，波浪噴湧。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingyuan, at an old well in a commoner's home on Mount Huang in Huizhou, on a night of wind and rain black qi emerged, with waves surging and spraying.
translations.idiomatic: In 1195, at an old well in a commoner's home on Mount Huang in Hui Prefecture, on a night of wind and rain black qi emerged, with waves surging and spraying.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年五月，撫州王羲之墨池水色變黑如雲。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Xianping, the ink pool of Wang Xizhi in Fuzhou changed color to black like clouds.
translations.idiomatic: In May 998, the ink pool of Wang Xizhi in Fu Prefecture changed color to black like clouds.

sentences.zh: 紹興十四年，樂平縣河沖裏田隴數十百頃，田中水類爲物所吸，聚爲一直行，高平地數尺，不假堤防而水自行；

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Shaoxing, a river in Leping County washed away several tens or hundreds of mu of fields in the interior; water in the fields seemed drawn by something, gathering into a single straight line, several chi higher than the level ground, flowing on its own without embankments;
translations.idiomatic: In 1144, a river in Leping County washed away several tens or hundreds of mu of interior fields; water in the fields seemed drawn by something, gathering into a single straight line several chi higher than the level ground and flowing on its own without embankments;

sentences.zh: 裏南程氏家井水溢，亦高數尺，夭矯如長虹，聲如雷，穿牆毀樓。

translations.literal: At the Cheng family's home to the south of the interior, well water overflowed, also rising several chi, writhing like a long rainbow, with a sound like thunder, piercing walls and destroying buildings.
translations.idiomatic: at the Cheng family's home to the south of the interior, well water overflowed, also rising several chi, writhing like a long rainbow with a sound like thunder, piercing walls and destroying buildings.

sentences.zh: 二水鬥於杉墩，且前且卻，約十刻乃解，各復故。

translations.literal: The two waters battled at Shandun, advancing and retreating for about ten double-hours before dispersing, each returning to its former state.
translations.idiomatic: The two waters battled at Shandun, advancing and retreating for about ten double-hours before dispersing, each returning to its former state.

sentences.zh: 天聖四年十月甲午，昏霧四塞。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu in the tenth month of the fourth year of Tiansheng, dusk mist closed in on all sides.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the tenth month in 1026, dusk mist closed in on all sides.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年正月丁未，霧氣四塞，對面不見。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei in the first month of the first year of Jingkang, mist closed in on all sides, and one could not see the person opposite.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the first month in 1126, mist closed in on all sides, and one could not see the person opposite.

sentences.zh: 建炎二年十一月甲子，北京大霧四塞，是夕，城陷。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi in the eleventh month of the second year of Jianyan, in the northern capital great fog closed in on all four sides; that night, the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the eleventh month in 1128, in the northern capital great fog closed in on all four sides; that night, the city fell.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，車駕發溫州航海，乙丑，次松門，海中白霧，晝晦。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year, the imperial carriage set out from Wenzhou by sea; on the day yichou it stopped at Songmen, and on the sea there was white fog, darkening the day.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of 1129, the imperial carriage set out from Wen Prefecture by sea; on the yichou day it stopped at Songmen, and on the sea white fog darkened the day.

sentences.zh: 六月，久陰。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, there was prolonged overcast weather.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1129, the weather remained overcast for a long time.

sentences.zh: 四年三月乙丑，四方霧下如塵。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the fourth month of the fourth year, fog descended on all four sides like dust.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the fourth month in 1130, fog descended on all four sides like dust.

sentences.zh: 紹興三年，自正月陰晦，陽光不舒者四十餘日。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxing, from the first month the weather was overcast and gloomy, and the sunlight did not break through for more than forty days.
translations.idiomatic: In 1133, from the first month the weather was overcast and gloomy, and sunlight did not break through for more than forty days.

sentences.zh: 五年正月甲申，霧氣昏塞。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen in the first month of the fifth year, mist closed in darkly.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the first month in 1135, mist closed in darkly.

sentences.zh: 七月，劉豫毀明堂，天地晦冥者累日。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Liu Yu destroyed the Bright Hall, and heaven and earth were dark and obscure for many days.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 1135, Liu Yu destroyed the Bright Hall, and heaven and earth were dark and obscure for many days.

sentences.zh: 七年，氛氣翳日。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, vaporous qi obscured the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In 1137, vaporous qi obscured the sun.

sentences.zh: 八年三月甲寅，晝晦，日無光，陰霧四塞。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the third month of the eighth year, the day was dark, the sun had no light, and yin mist closed in on all sides.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the third month in 1138, the day was dark, the sun had no light, and yin mist closed in on all sides.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，晝夜雲氣昧濁。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, day and night the cloud qi was murky and turbid.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, day and night the cloud qi was murky and turbid.

sentences.zh: 四月，積雨方止，氛霧四塞，晝日無光。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, accumulated rain had just stopped, and vaporous mist closed in on all sides; in the daytime there was no sunlight.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of 1138, accumulated rain had just stopped, and vaporous mist closed in on all sides; in the daytime there was no sunlight.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年五月丙午，朝霧四塞。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the fifth month of the first year of Longxing, morning mist closed in on all four sides.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the fifth month in 1163, morning mist closed in on all four sides.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，積陰彌月。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year, overcast weather lasted a full month.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1164, overcast weather lasted a full month.

sentences.zh: 乾道二年十一月，久陰。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year of Qiandao, there was prolonged overcast weather.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of 1166, the weather remained overcast for a long time.

sentences.zh: 五年正月甲申，晝蒙。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen in the first month of the fifth year, the day was shrouded.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the first month in 1169, the day was shrouded in haze.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，連陰。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year, overcast weather continued.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of 1170, overcast weather continued.

sentences.zh: 六月，日青無光。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the sun was green and had no light.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1170, the sun turned greenish and lost its light.

sentences.zh: 淳熙六年十二月乙丑，晝蒙。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the twelfth month of the sixth year of Chunxi, the day was shrouded.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the twelfth month in 1179, the day was shrouded in haze.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月丁亥，亦如之。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the first month of the thirteenth year, it was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the first month in 1186, it was likewise.

sentences.zh: 慶元二年一月己卯，晝暝，四方昏塞。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the first month of the second year of Qingyuan, the day was dark, and all four sides were closed in by gloom.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the first month in 1196, the day was dark, and gloom closed in on all four sides.

sentences.zh: 三年二月丁卯，晝晦，昏霧四塞。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the second month of the third year, the day was dark, and dusk mist closed in on all four sides.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the second month in 1197, the day was dark, and dusk mist closed in on all four sides.

sentences.zh: 六年十二月辛卯、嘉定三年正月丙午、十年正月乙未、十三年三月壬辰，皆晝蒙。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao in the twelfth month of the sixth year, on the day bingwu in the first month of the third year of Jiading, on the day yiwei in the first month of the tenth year, and on the day renchen in the third month of the thirteenth year, the day was shrouded in each case.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the twelfth month in 1200, the bingwu day of the first month in 1210, the yiwei day of the first month in 1217, and the renchen day of the third month in 1220, the day was shrouded in haze.

sentences.zh: 建炎四年三月辛亥，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the third month of the fourth year of Jianyan, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the third month in 1130, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 紹興八年三月辛巳，白虹亙天。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi in the third month of the eighth year of Shaoxing, a white rainbow stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the third month in 1138, a white rainbow stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 二十七年二月壬寅，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the second month of the twenty-seventh year, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the second month in 1157, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 三十年十二月辛酉，曲虹見日之西。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou in the twelfth month of the thirtieth year, a curved rainbow appeared west of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the twelfth month in 1160, a curved rainbow appeared west of the sun.

sentences.zh: 乾道三年十月丙申，虹見。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the tenth month of the third year of Qiandao, a rainbow appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the tenth month in 1167, a rainbow appeared.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年十月戊寅，曲虹見日東。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the tenth month of the first year of Chunxi, a curved rainbow appeared east of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the tenth month in 1174, a curved rainbow appeared east of the sun.

sentences.zh: 二年十月庚辰，虹見。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen in the tenth month of the second year, a rainbow appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the tenth month in 1175, a rainbow appeared.

sentences.zh: 五年十月丁巳，曲虹見日東。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the tenth month of the fifth year, a curved rainbow appeared east of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the tenth month in 1178, a curved rainbow appeared east of the sun.

sentences.zh: 慶元元年正月丙辰，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the first month of the first year of Qingyuan, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the first month in 1195, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰三年七月壬午，亦如之。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the seventh month of the third year of Jiatai, it was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the seventh month in 1203, it was likewise.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月，虹見。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fourth year, a rainbow appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of 1204, a rainbow appeared.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十一年二月丙辰，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the second month of the eleventh year of Jiading, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the second month in 1218, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙三年十月乙丑，虹見。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the tenth month of the third year of Jiaxi, a rainbow appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the tenth month in 1239, a rainbow appeared.

sentences.zh: 四年二月辛丑，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou in the second month of the fourth year, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the second month in 1240, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 淳祐十年十二月丁巳，虹見。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the twelfth month of the tenth year of Chunyou, a rainbow appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the twelfth month in 1250, a rainbow appeared.

sentences.zh: 寶祐五年十月，虹見。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fifth year of Baoyou, a rainbow appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of 1257, a rainbow appeared.

sentences.zh: 太祖從周世宗征淮南，戰于江亭，有龍自水中向太祖奮躍。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taizu followed Emperor Shizong of Zhou in the campaign against Huainan and fought at Jiangting, a dragon leapt toward Taizu from the water.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Taizu followed Emperor Shizong of Zhou in the campaign against Huainan and fought at Jiangting, a dragon leapt toward him from the water.

sentences.zh: 乾德五年夏，京師雨，有黑龍見尾於雲際，自西北趨東南。

translations.literal: In summer of the fifth year of Qiande, when it rained in the capital, a black dragon showed its tail in the clouds, rushing from the northwest toward the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of 967, when it rained in the capital, a black dragon showed its tail in the clouds, rushing from the northwest toward the southeast.

sentences.zh: 占主大水。

translations.literal: Prognostication indicated great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication indicated a great flood.

sentences.zh: 明年，州府二十四水壞田廬。

translations.literal: The next year, in twenty-four prefectures floodwaters destroyed fields and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, floodwaters in twenty-four prefectures destroyed fields and dwellings.

sentences.zh: 開寶六年四月，單父縣民王美家龍起井中，暴雨飄廬舍，失族屬，及壞舊鎮廨舍三百五十余區，大木皆折。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the sixth year of Kaibao, at the home of the commoner Wang Mei in Shanfu County a dragon rose from a well; violent rain swept away dwellings, and he lost his clan relatives; it also destroyed the old town office buildings, more than three hundred fifty sections, and large trees were all snapped.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of 973, at the home of the commoner Wang Mei in Shanfu County a dragon rose from a well; violent rain swept away dwellings, and he lost his clan relatives; it also destroyed more than three hundred fifty sections of the old town office buildings, and large trees were all snapped.

sentences.zh: 七年六月，棣州有火自空墮於城北門樓，有物抱東柱，龍形金色，足三尺許，其氣甚腥。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year, in Dizhou fire fell from the sky onto the north gate tower; a thing embraced the eastern pillar, dragon-shaped and golden in color, with feet about three chi, and its qi was very foul.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 974, in Di Prefecture fire fell from the sky onto the north gate tower; a thing embraced the eastern pillar, dragon-shaped and golden in color, with feet about three chi, and its breath was very foul.

sentences.zh: 旦視之，壁上有煙痕，爪跡三十六。

translations.literal: At dawn one saw on the wall smoke marks and thirty-six claw tracks.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn, smoke marks and thirty-six claw tracks were found on the wall.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符二年八月，青蛇出無爲軍廨，長數尺。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu, a green snake emerged from the yamen of Wuwei Army; it was several chi long.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of 1009, a green snake emerged from the yamen of Wuwei Army; it was several chi long.

sentences.zh: 宣和元年夏，雨，晝夜凡數日。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Xuanhe, rain fell day and night for several days.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of 1119, rain fell day and night for several days.

sentences.zh: 及霽，開封縣前茶肆中有異物如犬大，蹲踞臥榻下。

translations.literal: When it cleared, in a teahouse in front of Kaifeng County there was a strange thing as large as a dog, crouching on a couch.
translations.idiomatic: When the rain cleared, in a teahouse in front of Kaifeng County there was a strange creature as large as a dog, crouching on a couch.

sentences.zh: 細視之，身僅六七尺，色蒼黑，其首類驢，兩頰作魚頷而色正綠，頂有角，生極長，於其際始分兩歧，聲如牛鳴，與世所繪龍無異。

translations.literal: Looking closely, its body was only six or seven chi, color dark green; its head resembled a donkey, both cheeks like fish jaws and color pure green; on its crown there was a horn growing extremely long, and at its tip it first divided into two prongs; its voice was like the lowing of an ox, no different from dragons painted in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Looking closely, its body was only six or seven chi, dark green in color; its head resembled a donkey, both cheeks like fish jaws and pure green; on its crown there was an extremely long horn that first divided into two prongs at the tip; its voice was like the lowing of an ox, no different from dragons painted in the world.

sentences.zh: 茶肆近軍器作坊，兵卒來觀，共殺食之。

translations.literal: The teahouse was near an armory workshop; soldiers came to look and together killed and ate it.
translations.idiomatic: The teahouse was near an armory workshop; soldiers came to look and together killed and ate it.

sentences.zh: 已而京城大水，訛言龍復仇云。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the capital had great flood, and a false rumor spread that the dragon had taken revenge.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the capital suffered great flood, and a false rumor spread that the dragon had taken revenge.

sentences.zh: 紹興初，朱勝非出守江州，過梁山，龍入其舟，才長數寸，赤背綠腹，白尾黑爪甲，目有光，近龍孽也。

translations.literal: In the early Shaoxing period, when Zhu Shengfei went out as prefect of Jiangzhou and passed Liangshan, a dragon entered his boat; it was only several cun long, with red back and green belly, white tail and black claws, eyes with light—a near dragon portent.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Shaoxing period, when Zhu Shengfei went out as prefect of Jiang Prefecture and passed Liangshan, a dragon entered his boat; it was only several cun long, with a red back and green belly, white tail and black claws, and luminous eyes—a near dragon portent.

sentences.zh: 行都柴垛橋旌忠廟三蛇出沒庭廡，大者盈尺，方鱗金色，首脊有金錢，遇霽，或變化數百於蕉卉間。

translations.literal: At the Jingzhong Shrine on Chaiduo Bridge in the traveling capital, three snakes appeared and vanished in the corridors; the largest was a full chi, with square scales and golden color, gold coins on the head and spine; when the weather cleared, they sometimes transformed into hundreds among plantain and flowers.
translations.idiomatic: At the Jingzhong Shrine on Chaiduo Bridge in the traveling capital, three snakes appeared and vanished in the corridors; the largest was a full chi, with square scales and golden color, gold coins on the head and spine; when the weather cleared, they sometimes transformed into hundreds among plantain and flowers.

sentences.zh: 廟徙而蛇孽亦絕。

translations.literal: When the shrine was moved, the snake portents also ceased.
translations.idiomatic: When the shrine was moved, the snake portents also ceased.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月，衡山縣淨居岩有蛇長二丈，身圍數尺，黑色而方文，震死，山水大至。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eleventh year, at Jingju Rock in Hengshan County there was a snake two zhang long, several chi in girth, black with square markings; it was struck dead by lightning, and great floodwaters came.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of 1141, at Jingju Rock in Hengshan County there was a snake two zhang long and several chi in girth, black with square markings; it was struck dead by lightning, and great floodwaters came.

sentences.zh: 先是，山氣遇夜輒昏昧，蛇斃始明。

translations.literal: Earlier, the mountain qi whenever night came was always dark and obscure; only when the snake died did it become bright.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the mountain air whenever night came was always dark and obscure; only when the snake died did it become bright.

sentences.zh: 二十五年六月，湖口縣赤龍橫水中如山，寒風怒濤，覆舟數十艘，士卒溺者數十人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-fifth year, at Chikou County a red dragon lay across the water like a mountain; cold wind and angry waves capsized several tens of boats, and several tens of soldiers drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1155, at Hukou County a red dragon lay across the water like a mountain; cold wind and angry waves capsized several tens of boats, and several tens of soldiers drowned.

sentences.zh: 三十年春，宜黃縣大蛇見於丞治，長二丈。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirtieth year, in Yihuang County a great snake appeared at the assistant magistrate's office; it was two zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of 1160, in Yihuang County a great snake appeared at the assistant magistrate's office; it was two zhang long.

sentences.zh: 捕之縱數里外，俄復至者數四。

translations.literal: When captured and released several li away, shortly it returned again, four times in all.
translations.idiomatic: When captured and released several li away, it shortly returned again, four times in all.

sentences.zh: 乾道五年七月乙亥，武甯縣龍鬥於復塘村，大雷雨，二龍奔逃，珠墜，大如車輪，牧童得之。

translations.literal: On the day yihai in the seventh month of the fifth year of Qiandao, at Futang Village in Wuning County dragons fought; there was great thunder and rain, and the two dragons fled in panic; a pearl fell, as large as a cart wheel, and a herd boy obtained it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the seventh month in 1169, at Futang Village in Wuning County dragons fought; there was great thunder and rain, and the two dragons fled in panic; a pearl fell, as large as a cart wheel, and a herd boy obtained it.

sentences.zh: 自是連歲有水災。

translations.literal: From then on there were flood disasters for successive years.
translations.idiomatic: From then on there were flood disasters for successive years.

sentences.zh: 太平興國三年，靈州獻官馬駒，足有二距。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taiping Xingguo, Lingzhou presented an official horse foal with spurs on both feet.
translations.idiomatic: In 978, Ling Prefecture presented an official horse foal with spurs on both feet.

sentences.zh: 雍熙二年，虔州吏李祚家馬生駒，足有距。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongxi, at the home of the clerk Li Zuo in Qian Prefecture a mare gave birth to a foal with spurs on its feet.
translations.idiomatic: In 985, at the home of the clerk Li Zuo in Qian Prefecture a mare gave birth to a foal with spurs on its feet.

sentences.zh: 四年，鄜州直羅縣民高英家馬生前兩足如牛。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, at the home of the commoner Gao Ying in Zhiluo County, Fuzhou, a mare gave birth with its forelegs like those of an ox.
translations.idiomatic: In 987, at the home of the commoner Gao Ying in Zhiluo County, Fu Prefecture, a mare gave birth to a foal whose forelegs were like those of an ox.

sentences.zh: 端拱二年，夏州民程真家馬生二駒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Duangong, at the home of the commoner Cheng Zhen in Xia Prefecture a mare gave birth to two foals.
translations.idiomatic: In 989, at the home of the commoner Cheng Zhen in Xia Prefecture a mare gave birth to two foals.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符九年十二月，大名監馬生駒，赤色，肉尾無騣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the ninth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, at the Daming horse stud a foal was born, red in color, with a fleshy tail and no mane.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of 1016, at the Daming horse stud a foal was born, red in color, with a fleshy tail and no mane.

sentences.zh: 宣和五年，馬生兩角，長三寸，四足皆生距。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuanhe, a horse was born with two horns three cun long, and all four feet grew spurs.
translations.idiomatic: In 1123, a horse was born with two horns three cun long, and all four feet grew spurs.

sentences.zh: 時北方正用兵。

translations.literal: At the time the north was actively using troops.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the north was actively using troops.

sentences.zh: 紹興八年，廣西海壖有海獸如馬，蹄鬣皆丹，夜入民舍。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Shaoxing, on the Guangxi seacoast there was a sea beast like a horse, with hooves and mane all red; at night it entered people's dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In 1138, on the Guangxi seacoast there was a sea beast like a horse, with hooves and mane all red; at night it entered people's dwellings.

sentences.zh: 聚衆殺之，明日海溢，環村百餘家皆溺死，近馬禍也。

translations.literal: The people gathered and killed it; the next day the sea overflowed, and more than one hundred households of the surrounding village all drowned—a near horse calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The people gathered and killed it; the next day the sea overflowed, and more than one hundred households of the surrounding village all drowned—a near horse calamity.

sentences.zh: 五年，廣西市馬，全綱疫死。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, tribute horses in Guangxi all died of plague in one convoy.
translations.idiomatic: In 1139, tribute horses in Guangxi all died of plague in one convoy.

sentences.zh: 淳熙六年十二月，宕昌西馬、金州馬皆大疫。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the sixth year of Chunxi, horses in Dangchang West and Jin Prefecture all suffered great plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of 1179, horses in Dangchang West and Jin Prefecture all suffered great plague.

sentences.zh: 十二年，黎、雅州獻馬，有角長二寸。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Li and Ya prefectures presented horses with horns two cun long.
translations.idiomatic: In 1185, Li and Ya prefectures presented horses with horns two cun long.

sentences.zh: 京房《易傳》曰：「臣易上，政不順，厥妖馬生角，茲謂賢士不足。」

translations.literal: Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes says: "When ministers change what is above, government is not compliant; its anomaly is horses born with horns—this is called insufficient worthy men."
translations.idiomatic: Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes says, "When ministers change what is above, government is not compliant; its anomaly is horses born with horns—this is called insufficient worthy men."

sentences.zh: 紹熙元年二月丙申，右丞相留正乘馬早朝，入禁扉，馬斃，近馬禍也。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the second month of the first year of Shaoxi, Chief Minister Liu Zheng rode his horse to the early audience; entering the forbidden gate, the horse died—a near horse calamity.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the second month in 1190, Chief Minister Liu Zheng rode his horse to the early audience; entering the forbidden gate, the horse died—a near horse calamity.

sentences.zh: 嘉定五年正月，史彌遠入賀于東宮，馬驚墮地，衣幘皆敗，其額微損，事與上同。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year of Jiading, Shi Miyuan entered the Eastern Palace to offer congratulations; his horse was startled and he fell to the ground; his clothes and cap were all torn, and his forehead was slightly injured—the matter was the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of 1212, Shi Miyuan entered the Eastern Palace to offer congratulations; his horse was startled and he fell to the ground; his clothes and cap were all torn, and his forehead was slightly injured—the matter was the same as above.

sentences.zh: 乾德三年，江陵府民劉暉妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qiande, the wife of the commoner Liu Hui of Jiangling Prefecture gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 965, the wife of the commoner Liu Hui of Jiangling Prefecture gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 四年，安州驍健軍卒趙遠妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the wife of the Xiaojian Army soldier Zhao Yuan of An Prefecture gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 966, the wife of the Xiaojian Army soldier Zhao Yuan of An Prefecture gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 五年，光州民高與、德州民趙嗣、乾甯軍卒王進妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the wife of the commoner Gao Yu of Guang Prefecture, the wife of the commoner Zhao Si of De Prefecture, and the wife of the Qianning Army soldier Wang Jin gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 967, the wife of the commoner Gao Yu of Guang Prefecture, the wife of the commoner Zhao Si of De Prefecture, and the wife of the Qianning Army soldier Wang Jin each gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 開寶元年，沂州民王政、澶州民謝興妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaibao, the wife of the commoner Wang Zheng of Yizhou and the wife of the commoner Xie Xing of Cao Prefecture gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 968, the wife of the commoner Wang Zheng of Yi Prefecture and the wife of the commoner Xie Xing of Cao Prefecture each gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 二年，閬州民孫延廣、開州民董遠妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the second year, the wife of the commoner Sun Yanguang of Lang Prefecture and the wife of the commoner Dong Yuan of Kai Prefecture gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 969, the wife of the commoner Sun Yanguang of Lang Prefecture and the wife of the commoner Dong Yuan of Kai Prefecture each gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 七年，青城縣王宥妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the wife of Wang You of Qingcheng County gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 974, the wife of Wang You of Qingcheng County gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 河南府民劉元妻產三男。

translations.literal: The wife of the commoner Liu Yuan of Henan Prefecture gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: The wife of the commoner Liu Yuan of Henan Prefecture gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 太平興國二年，邢州招收軍卒李遇、汝州歸化軍卒魚霸、常州民謝祚妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taiping Xingguo, the wife of the recruitment army soldier Li Yu of Xing Prefecture, the wife of the Guihua Army soldier Yu Ba of Ru Prefecture, and the wife of the commoner Xie Zuo of Chang Prefecture gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 977, the wife of the recruitment army soldier Li Yu of Xing Prefecture, the wife of the Guihua Army soldier Yu Ba of Ru Prefecture, and the wife of the commoner Xie Zuo of Chang Prefecture each gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 晉原縣民楊萬妻產三男。

translations.literal: The wife of the commoner Yang Wan of Jinyuan County gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: The wife of the commoner Yang Wan of Jinyuan County gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 七年，澶州龍衛軍卒靳興、普州民鄭彥福妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the wife of the Longwei Army soldier Jin Xing of Cao Prefecture and the wife of the commoner Zheng Yanfu of Pu Prefecture gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 982, the wife of the Longwei Army soldier Jin Xing of Cao Prefecture and the wife of the commoner Zheng Yanfu of Pu Prefecture each gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 汾州民鄭訓妻產三女。

translations.literal: The wife of the commoner Zheng Xun of Fen Prefecture gave birth to three girls.
translations.idiomatic: The wife of the commoner Zheng Xun of Fen Prefecture gave birth to three girls.

sentences.zh: 雁門縣民劉習妻產四男。

translations.literal: The wife of the commoner Liu Xi of Yanmen County gave birth to four boys.
translations.idiomatic: The wife of the commoner Liu Xi of Yanmen County gave birth to four boys.

sentences.zh: 滑州歸化軍卒安旺妻產二男一女。

translations.literal: The wife of the Guihua Army soldier An Wang of Huazhou gave birth to two boys and one girl.
translations.idiomatic: The wife of the Guihua Army soldier An Wang of Hua Prefecture gave birth to two boys and one girl.

sentences.zh: 八年，揚州順化軍卒俞釗、溫州民李遇、榮州民李祚妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the wife of the Shunhua Army soldier Yu Zhao of Yang Prefecture, the wife of the commoner Li Yu of Wen Prefecture, and the wife of the commoner Li Zuo of Rong Prefecture gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 983, the wife of the Shunhua Army soldier Yu Zhao of Yang Prefecture, the wife of the commoner Li Yu of Wen Prefecture, and the wife of the commoner Li Zuo of Rong Prefecture each gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 九年，揚子縣民妻生男，毛被體半寸餘，面長、頂高、烏肩、眉毛粗密，近發際有毛兩道軟長眉，紫唇、紅耳、厚鼻、大類西域僧。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, a commoner's wife in Yangzi County gave birth to a boy with hair covering the body half a cun or more, long face, high crown, black shoulders, thick eyebrows, near the hairline two lines of soft long eyebrows, purple lips, red ears, thick nose—greatly resembling a Western Regions monk.
translations.idiomatic: In 984, a commoner's wife in Yangzi County gave birth to a boy with hair covering the body half a cun or more, a long face, high crown, black shoulders, thick eyebrows, and near the hairline two lines of soft long eyebrows, purple lips, red ears, and a thick nose—greatly resembling a Western Regions monk.

sentences.zh: 至三歲，畫圖以獻。

translations.literal: At the age of three, a portrait was painted and presented.
translations.idiomatic: At the age of three, a portrait was painted and presented to the court.

sentences.zh: 雍熙二年，奉新縣民何靖妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongxi, the wife of the commoner He Jing of Fengxin County gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 985, the wife of the commoner He Jing of Fengxin County gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 三年，魯山縣民張美、相州林慮縣民張欽妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the third year, the wife of the commoner Zhang Mei of Lushan County and the wife of the commoner Zhang Qin of Linlu County, Xiang Prefecture, gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 986, the wife of the commoner Zhang Mei of Lushan County and the wife of the commoner Zhang Qin of Linlu County, Xiang Prefecture, each gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 四年，晉原縣民周承暉、固始縣民楊升妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the wife of the commoner Zhou Chenghui of Jinyuan County and the wife of the commoner Yang Sheng of Gushi County gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 987, the wife of the commoner Zhou Chenghui of Jinyuan County and the wife of the commoner Yang Sheng of Gushi County each gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年，台州永安縣王旺、澶州靜戎軍卒鄭穗妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianping, Wang Wang of Yong'an County, Taizhou, and the wife of the Jingrong Army soldier Zheng Sui of Cao Prefecture gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 998, Wang Wang of Yong'an County, Tai Prefecture, and the wife of the Jingrong Army soldier Zheng Sui of Cao Prefecture each gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 莘縣民懷梁、獲嘉縣民王貴、永康縣民羅彥瑫、溫縣民楊榮、毗陵縣民魏吉妻產三男。

translations.literal: The wife of the commoner Huai Liang of Shen County, the wife of the commoner Wang Gui of Huojia County, the wife of the commoner Luo Yantang of Yongkang County, the wife of the commoner Yang Rong of Wen County, and the wife of the commoner Wei Ji of Piling County gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: The wife of the commoner Huai Liang of Shen County, the wife of the commoner Wang Gui of Huojia County, the wife of the commoner Luo Yantang of Yongkang County, the wife of the commoner Yang Rong of Wen County, and the wife of the commoner Wei Ji of Piling County each gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 三年，睢縣民朱進、鄆州武威軍卒徐繞、深州民彭遠妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the third year, the wife of the commoner Zhu Jin of Sui County, the wife of the Wuwei Army soldier Xu Rao of Yun Prefecture, and the wife of the commoner Peng Yuan of Shen Prefecture gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 1000, the wife of the commoner Zhu Jin of Sui County, the wife of the Wuwei Army soldier Xu Rao of Yun Prefecture, and the wife of the commoner Peng Yuan of Shen Prefecture each gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 四年，望都縣民郭瑩、邕州澄海軍卒梁濟妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the wife of the commoner Guo Ying of Wangdu County and the wife of the Chenghai Army soldier Liang Ji of Yong Prefecture gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 1001, the wife of the commoner Guo Ying of Wangdu County and the wife of the Chenghai Army soldier Liang Ji of Yong Prefecture each gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 五年，夏津縣民趙替妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the wife of the commoner Zhao Ti of Xiajin County gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 1002, the wife of the commoner Zhao Ti of Xiajin County gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 六年，石城縣民劉詵、堂邑縣民戴玉妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the wife of the commoner Liu Shen of Shicheng County and the wife of the commoner Dai Yu of Tangyi County gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 1003, the wife of the commoner Liu Shen of Shicheng County and the wife of the commoner Dai Yu of Tangyi County each gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 平鄉縣民郭讓妻產四男。

translations.literal: The wife of the commoner Guo Rang of Pingxiang County gave birth to four boys.
translations.idiomatic: The wife of the commoner Guo Rang of Pingxiang County gave birth to four boys.

sentences.zh: 景德元年，南昌縣民李聰妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingde, the wife of the commoner Li Cong of Nanchang County gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 1004, the wife of the commoner Li Cong of Nanchang County gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 二年，奉新縣民魏勇妻產三男。

translations.literal: In the second year, the wife of the commoner Wei Yong of Fengxin County gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 1005, the wife of the commoner Wei Yong of Fengxin County gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 四年，八作司匠趙榮、南頓縣民任登老、棗強縣民張緒妻各產三男。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the artisan Zhao Rong of the Eight Works Office, the commoner Ren Denglao of Nandun County, and the wife of the commoner Zhang Xu of Zaoqiang County each gave birth to three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In 1007, the artisan Zhao Rong of the Eight Works Office, the commoner Ren Denglao of Nandun County, and the wife of the commoner Zhang Xu of Zaoqiang County each gave birth to three boys.

sentences.zh: 自天聖迄治平，婦人生四男者二，生三男者四十四，生二男一女者一。

translations.literal: From Tiansheng through Zhiping, women who gave birth to four boys numbered two, those who gave birth to three boys numbered forty-four, and those who gave birth to two boys and one girl numbered one.
translations.idiomatic: From the Tiansheng through Zhiping eras, women who gave birth to four boys numbered two, those who gave birth to three boys numbered forty-four, and those who gave birth to two boys and one girl numbered one.

sentences.zh: 熙甯元年距元豐七年，郡邑民家生三男者八十四，而四男者一，三男一女者一。

translations.literal: From the first year of Xining through the seventh year of Yuanfeng, among common households in commanderies and counties those who gave birth to three boys numbered eighty-four, while those who gave birth to four boys numbered one, and those who gave birth to three boys and one girl numbered one.
translations.idiomatic: From 1068 through 1084, among common households in commanderies and counties those who gave birth to three boys numbered eighty-four, while those who gave birth to four boys numbered one, and those who gave birth to three boys and one girl numbered one.

sentences.zh: 元豐八年至元符二年，生三男者十八，而四男者二，三男一女者一。

translations.literal: From the eighth year of Yuanfeng through the second year of Yuanfu, those who gave birth to three boys numbered eighteen, while those who gave birth to four boys numbered two, and those who gave birth to three boys and one girl numbered one.
translations.idiomatic: From 1085 through 1099, those who gave birth to three boys numbered eighteen, while those who gave birth to four boys numbered two, and those who gave birth to three boys and one girl numbered one.

sentences.zh: 元符三年至靖康，生三男者十九，而四男者一。

translations.literal: From the third year of Yuanfu through Jingkang, those who gave birth to three boys numbered nineteen, while those who gave birth to four boys numbered one.
translations.idiomatic: From 1100 through the Jingkang period, those who gave birth to three boys numbered nineteen, while those who gave birth to four boys numbered one.

sentences.zh: 前志以爲人民蕃息之驗。

translations.literal: The earlier treatise took this as evidence of the people's increase and flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: The earlier treatise took this as evidence of population increase and flourishing.

sentences.zh: 宣和六年，都城有賣青果男子，孕而生子，蓐母不能收，易七人，始免而逃去。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xuanhe, in the capital there was a man who sold green fruit; he was pregnant and gave birth to a child; the midwife could not deliver it, and after seven people were changed he finally escaped and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In 1124, in the capital there was a man who sold green fruit; he was pregnant and gave birth to a child; the midwife could not deliver it, and after seven midwives were tried he finally escaped and fled.

sentences.zh: 豐樂樓酒保朱氏子之妻，可四十余，楚州人，忽生髭，長僅六七寸，疏秀而美，宛然一男子，特詔度爲女道士。

translations.literal: The daughter-in-law of Zhu the wine steward at Fengle Tower was about forty or more, a native of Chuzhou; she suddenly grew a beard only six or seven cun long, sparse, elegant, and beautiful, exactly like a man; by special edict she was ordained a female Daoist.
translations.idiomatic: The daughter-in-law of Zhu the wine steward at Fengle Tower was about forty or more, a native of Chu Prefecture; she suddenly grew a beard only six or seven cun long, sparse, elegant, and beautiful, exactly like a man's; by special edict she was ordained a female Daoist.

sentences.zh: 紹興三年，建康府桐林灣婦產子，肉角、有齒。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxing, at Tonglin Bay in Jiankang Prefecture a woman gave birth to a child with fleshy horns and teeth.
translations.idiomatic: In 1133, at Tonglin Bay in Jiankang Prefecture a woman gave birth to a child with fleshy horns and teeth.

sentences.zh: 是歲，人多產鱗毛。

translations.literal: In that year, many people gave birth to children with scaly hair.
translations.idiomatic: That year, many people gave birth to children with scaly hair.

sentences.zh: 二十年八月，真符縣民家一產三男。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twentieth year, at a commoner's home in Zhenfu County one birth produced three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of 1150, at a commoner's home in Zhenfu County one birth produced three boys.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年，建康民流寓行都而婦產子，二首具羽毛之形。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longxing, a woman from Jiankang who had drifted to the traveling capital gave birth; the child had two heads, both with the form of feathers.
translations.idiomatic: In 1163, a woman from Jiankang who had drifted to the traveling capital gave birth; the child had two heads, both bearing the form of feathers.

sentences.zh: 乾道五年，衡、湘間人有化爲虎者。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Qiandao, among the people between Heng and Xiang there were those who transformed into tigers.
translations.idiomatic: In 1169, among the people between Heng and Xiang there were those who transformed into tigers.

sentences.zh: 余杭縣婦產子，青而毛，二肉角，又有二家婦產子亦如之，皆連體兩面相鄉。

translations.literal: A woman in Yuhang County gave birth to a child, green and hairy, with two fleshy horns; again two other households' wives gave birth to children likewise, all conjoined with two faces toward each other.
translations.idiomatic: A woman in Yuhang County gave birth to a child, green and hairy, with two fleshy horns; two other households' wives also gave birth to similar children, all conjoined twins with faces toward each other.

sentences.zh: 三家才相距一二里。

translations.literal: The three households were only one or two li apart.
translations.idiomatic: The three households were only one or two li apart.

sentences.zh: 潮州城西婦孕過期產子，如指大、五體皆具者百餘，蠕蠕能動。

translations.literal: A woman west of Chaozhou city was overdue in pregnancy and gave birth to more than one hundred children, each like a finger in size, with all five limbs complete, wriggling and able to move.
translations.idiomatic: A woman west of Chaozhou city was overdue in pregnancy and gave birth to more than one hundred children, each finger-sized, with all five limbs complete, wriggling and able to move.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十年，番昜南鄉婦產子，肘各有二臂，及長，鬥則六臂並運。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Chunxi, a woman in the southern township of Poyang gave birth to a child with two arms on each elbow; when grown, in fighting all six arms moved together.
translations.idiomatic: In 1183, a woman in the southern township of Poyang gave birth to a child with two arms on each elbow; when grown, in fighting all six arms moved together.

sentences.zh: 十三年，行都有人死十有四日復生。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, in the traveling capital a man died and after fourteen days revived.
translations.idiomatic: In 1186, in the traveling capital a man died and after fourteen days revived.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，鄧家巷婦產肉塊三，其一直目而橫口。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei in the eleventh month, a woman in Dengjia Lane gave birth to three lumps of flesh; one had upright eyes and a horizontal mouth.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the eleventh month in 1186, a woman in Dengjia Lane gave birth to three lumps of flesh; one had upright eyes and a horizontal mouth.

sentences.zh: 十四年六月，臨安府浦頭婦產子，生而能言，四日。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourteenth year, a woman at Putou in Lin'an Prefecture gave birth to a child who was able to speak from birth; on the fourth day
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1187, a woman at Putou in Lin'an Prefecture gave birth to a child who was able to speak from birth; on the fourth day

sentences.zh: 暴長四尺。

translations.literal: it suddenly grew four chi tall.
translations.idiomatic: it suddenly grew four chi tall.

sentences.zh: 紹熙元年三月癸酉，行都市人夜以殺相驚，奔迸者良久乃定。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the third month of the first year of Shaoxi, at night in the traveling capital people were alarmed by rumors of killing, and those fleeing in panic did not settle until after a long time.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the third month in 1190, at night in the traveling capital people were alarmed by rumors of killing, and those fleeing in panic did not settle until after a long time.

sentences.zh: 是歲，昆山縣工採石而山壓。

translations.literal: In that year, at Kunshan County workers quarrying stone were crushed by the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: That year, at Kunshan County workers quarrying stone were crushed by the mountain.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，它工採石鄰山，聞其聲呼，相應答如平生。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year, other workers quarrying stone on a neighboring mountain heard voices calling; they answered one another as in ordinary life.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1192, other workers quarrying stone on a neighboring mountain heard voices calling; they answered one another as in ordinary life.

sentences.zh: 其家鑿石出之，見其妻，喜曰：「久閉乍風，肌膚如裂。」

translations.literal: That family quarried the stone and brought her out; seeing his wife, he said with joy: "Long shut in, suddenly exposed to wind, the skin is like cracking."
translations.idiomatic: That family quarried the stone and brought her out; seeing his wife, he said with joy, "Long shut in, suddenly exposed to wind, the skin feels like cracking."

sentences.zh: 俄頃，聲微噤不語，化爲石人，貌如生。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward, her voice grew faint and she fell silent, and turned into a stone person, her appearance like one alive.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, her voice grew faint and she fell silent, and turned into a stone figure, her appearance like one alive.

sentences.zh: 慶元元年，樂平縣民婦產子有尾。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingyuan, a commoner's wife in Leping County gave birth to a child with a tail.
translations.idiomatic: In 1195, a commoner's wife in Leping County gave birth to a child with a tail.

sentences.zh: 永州民產子首有角，腋有肉翅。

translations.literal: A commoner in Yong Prefecture gave birth to a child with horns on the head and fleshy wings in the armpits.
translations.idiomatic: A commoner in Yong Prefecture gave birth to a child with horns on the head and fleshy wings in the armpits.

sentences.zh: 二年七月，進賢縣婦產子亦如之，而面有三目。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year, a woman in Jinxian County gave birth to a child likewise, but with three eyes on the face.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 1196, a woman in Jinxian County gave birth to a similar child, but with three eyes on the face.

sentences.zh: 嘉定四年四月，鎮江府後軍妻生子，一身二首而四臂。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year of Jiading, the wife of a soldier of the Rear Army in Zhenjiang Prefecture gave birth to a child with one body, two heads, and four arms.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of 1211, the wife of a soldier of the Rear Army in Zhenjiang Prefecture gave birth to a child with one body, two heads, and four arms.

sentences.zh: 淳化五年六月，京師疫，遣太醫和藥救之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year of Chunhua, in the capital there was pestilence; imperial physicians were sent to compound medicine and treat the sick.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 994, pestilence struck the capital; imperial physicians were sent to compound medicine and treat the sick.

sentences.zh: 至道二年，江南頻年多疾疫。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhidao, south of the Yangzi for successive years there was much pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In 996, south of the Yangzi suffered pestilence for successive years.

sentences.zh: 大觀三年，江東疫。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daguan, east of the Yangzi suffered pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In 1109, the region east of the Yangzi suffered pestilence.

sentences.zh: 建炎元年三月，金人圍汴京，城中疫死者幾半。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Jianyan, the Jurchens besieged Bianjing; in the city those who died of pestilence were nearly half.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of 1127, the Jurchens besieged Bianjing; in the city nearly half the people died of pestilence.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年六月，浙西大疫，平江府以北，流屍無算。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Shaoxing, in western Zhe there was great pestilence; north of Pingjiang Prefecture, floating corpses were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1131, western Zhe suffered great pestilence; north of Pingjiang Prefecture, floating corpses were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 秋冬，紹興府連年大疫，官募人能服粥藥之勞者，活及百人者度爲僧。

translations.literal: In autumn and winter, Shaoxing Prefecture suffered great pestilence for successive years; the government recruited men able to labor at serving congee and medicine; those who saved as many as one hundred lives were ordained as monks.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn and winter, Shaoxing Prefecture suffered great pestilence for successive years; the government recruited men able to labor at serving congee and medicine; those who saved as many as one hundred lives were ordained as monks.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，永州疫。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, Yong Prefecture had pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of 1133, Yong Prefecture suffered pestilence.

sentences.zh: 六年，四川疫。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Sichuan had pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In 1136, Sichuan suffered pestilence.

sentences.zh: 十六年夏，行都疫。

translations.literal: In the summer of the sixteenth year, the traveling capital had pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of 1146, the traveling capital suffered pestilence.

sentences.zh: 二十六年夏，行都又疫，高宗出柴胡制藥，活者甚衆。

translations.literal: In the summer of the twenty-sixth year, the traveling capital again had pestilence; Emperor Gaozong issued bupleurum medicine, and very many were saved.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of 1156, the traveling capital again suffered pestilence; Emperor Gaozong issued bupleurum medicine, and very many were saved.

sentences.zh: 隆興二年冬，淮甸流民二三十萬避亂江南，結草舍遍山谷，暴露凍餒，疫死者半，僅有還者亦死。

translations.literal: In the winter of the second year of Longxing, two or three hundred thousand displaced people from the Huai region fled chaos to south of the Yangzi, building grass huts throughout the mountains and valleys; exposed to cold and hunger, half died of pestilence, and even those who returned also died.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of 1164, two or three hundred thousand displaced people from the Huai region fled chaos to south of the Yangzi, building grass huts throughout the mountains and valleys; exposed to cold and hunger, half died of pestilence, and even those who returned also died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，浙之饑民疫者尤衆。

translations.literal: In that year, among the famine-stricken people of Zhe those with pestilence were especially numerous.
translations.idiomatic: That year, among the famine-stricken people of Zhe those with pestilence were especially numerous.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年，行都及紹興府饑，民大疫，浙東、西亦如之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qiandao, the traveling capital and Shaoxing Prefecture suffered famine; the people had great pestilence, and eastern and western Zhe were likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In 1165, the traveling capital and Shaoxing Prefecture suffered famine; the people were struck by great pestilence, and eastern and western Zhe were likewise.

sentences.zh: 六年春，民以冬燠疫作。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year, because of the warm winter the people suffered pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of 1170, because of the warm winter the people suffered pestilence.

sentences.zh: 八年夏，行都民疫，及秋未息。

translations.literal: In the summer of the eighth year, the people of the traveling capital had pestilence, which by autumn had not ceased.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of 1172, the people of the traveling capital suffered pestilence, which by autumn had not ceased.

sentences.zh: 江西饑民大疫，隆興府民疫，遭水患，多死。

translations.literal: The famine-stricken people of Jiangxi had great pestilence; the people of Longxing Prefecture had pestilence and suffered flood disaster, and many died.
translations.idiomatic: The famine-stricken people of Jiangxi suffered great pestilence; the people of Longxing Prefecture suffered pestilence and flood disaster, and many died.

sentences.zh: 淳熙四年，真州大疫。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chunxi, Zhen Prefecture had great pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In 1177, Zhen Prefecture suffered great pestilence.

sentences.zh: 八年，行都大疫，禁旅多死。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the traveling capital had great pestilence, and many in the palace guard died.
translations.idiomatic: In 1181, the traveling capital suffered great pestilence, and many in the palace guard died.

sentences.zh: 甯國府民疫死者尤衆。

translations.literal: Among the people of Ningguo Prefecture those who died of pestilence were especially numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Among the people of Ningguo Prefecture those who died of pestilence were especially numerous.

sentences.zh: 十四年春，都民、禁旅大疫，浙西郡國亦疫。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourteenth year, the people of the capital and the palace guard had great pestilence, and the commanderies and states of western Zhe also had pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of 1187, the people of the capital and the palace guard suffered great pestilence, and the commanderies and states of western Zhe also suffered pestilence.

sentences.zh: 十六年，潭州疫。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Tan Prefecture had pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In 1189, Tan Prefecture suffered pestilence.

sentences.zh: 紹興二年春，涪州疫死數千人。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year of Shaoxi, in Fu Prefecture several thousand died of pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of 1191, in Fu Prefecture several thousand died of pestilence.

sentences.zh: 三年，資、榮二州大疫。

translations.literal: In the third year, Zi and Rong prefectures had great pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In 1192, Zi and Rong prefectures suffered great pestilence.

sentences.zh: 慶元元年，行都疫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingyuan, the traveling capital had pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In 1195, the traveling capital suffered pestilence.

sentences.zh: 二年五月，行都疫。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, the traveling capital had pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of 1196, the traveling capital suffered pestilence.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，行都及淮、浙郡縣疫。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year, the traveling capital and the prefectures and counties of the Huai and Zhe had pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of 1197, the traveling capital and the prefectures and counties of the Huai and Zhe suffered pestilence.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰三年五月，行都疫。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the third year of Jiatai, the traveling capital had pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of 1203, the traveling capital suffered pestilence.

sentences.zh: 嘉定元年夏，淮甸大疫，官募掩骼及二百人者度爲僧。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Jiading, in the Huai region there was great pestilence; the government recruited those who buried bones reaching two hundred, and they were ordained as monks.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of 1208, the Huai region suffered great pestilence; the government recruited those who buried as many as two hundred corpses and ordained them as monks.

sentences.zh: 是歲，浙民亦疫。

translations.literal: In that year, the people of Zhe also had pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the people of Zhe also suffered pestilence.

sentences.zh: 二年夏，都民疫死甚衆。

translations.literal: In the summer of the second year, very many among the people of the capital died of pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of 1209, very many among the people of the capital died of pestilence.

sentences.zh: 淮民流江南者饑與暑並，多疫死。

translations.literal: Huai people who drifted south of the Yangzi suffered hunger together with heat, and many died of pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: Huai people who drifted south of the Yangzi suffered hunger together with heat, and many died of pestilence.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，都民多疫死。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, very many among the people of the capital died of pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of 1210, very many among the people of the capital died of pestilence.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，亦如之。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year, it was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of 1211, it was likewise.

sentences.zh: 十五年，贛州疫。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Gan Prefecture had pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In 1222, Gan Prefecture suffered pestilence.

sentences.zh: 十六年，永、道二州疫。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Yong and Dao prefectures had pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: In 1223, Yong and Dao prefectures suffered pestilence.

sentences.zh: 德祐元年六月庚子，是日，四城遷徙，流民患疫而死者不可勝計，天甯寺死者尤多。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the sixth month of the first year of Deyou, on that day the four wards were relocated; displaced people suffered pestilence and those who died were beyond counting, and at Tianning Temple the dead were especially numerous.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the sixth month in 1275, the four wards were relocated; displaced people suffered pestilence and those who died were beyond counting, and at Tianning Temple the dead were especially numerous.

sentences.zh: 二年閏三月，數月間，城中疫氣薰蒸，人之病死者不可以數計。

translations.literal: In the intercalary third month of the second year, over several months pestilential qi steamed in the city; those who sickened and died could not be counted.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month of 1276, over several months pestilential qi steamed in the city; those who sickened and died could not be counted.

sentences.zh: 熙甯元年七月戊子夜，西南雲間有聲鳴，如風水相激，寢週四方。

translations.literal: On the night of the day wuzi in the seventh month of the first year of Xining, among the clouds in the southwest there was a sound like crying, like wind and water striking one another, spreading around the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the wuzi day of the seventh month in 1068, among the clouds in the southwest there was a sound like crying, like wind and water striking one another, spreading around the four directions.

sentences.zh: 主民勞，兵革歲動。

translations.literal: Prognostication indicated the people's toil; war and weapons moved every year.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication indicated the people's toil; war and weapons moved every year.

sentences.zh: 六年七月丙寅夜，西北雲間有聲如磨物，主百姓勞。

translations.literal: On the night of the day bingyin in the seventh month of the sixth year, among the clouds in the northwest there was a sound like grinding things; prognostication indicated the common people's toil.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the bingyin day of the seventh month in 1073, among the clouds in the northwest there was a sound like grinding things; prognostication indicated the common people's toil.

sentences.zh: 七年七月庚子夜，西北天嗚，主驚憂之事。

translations.literal: On the night of the day gengzi in the seventh month of the seventh year, the sky cried out; prognostication indicated matters of alarm and worry.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the gengzi day of the seventh month in 1074, the sky cried out; prognostication indicated matters of alarm and worry.

sentences.zh: 紹興二十一年八月乙亥，天有聲如雷，水響于東南，四日乃止。

translations.literal: On the day yihai in the eighth month of the twenty-first year of Shaoxing, the sky had a sound like thunder, and a water sound in the southeast; after four days it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the eighth month in 1151, the sky had a sound like thunder, and a water sound in the southeast; after four days it stopped.

sentences.zh: 開禧元年六月壬寅，天鳴有聲。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the sixth month of the first year of Kaixi, the sky cried out with a sound.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the sixth month in 1205, the sky cried out with a sound.

sentences.zh: 天禧三年正月晦，沈丘縣民駱新田聞震，頃之，隕石入地七尺許。

translations.literal: On the last day of the first month of the third year of Tianxi, the commoner Luo Xintian of Shenqiu County heard thunder; shortly afterward, a meteorite fell into the ground about seven chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the first month in 1019, the commoner Luo Xintian of Shenqiu County heard thunder; shortly afterward, a meteorite fell into the ground about seven chi deep.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十六年三月壬寅，隕石于楚州寶應縣，散如火，甚臭腥。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the third month of the sixteenth year of Chunxi, a meteorite fell in Baoying County, Chuzhou, scattering like fire, very foul and bloody in smell.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the third month in 1189, a meteorite fell in Baoying County, Chu Prefecture, scattering like fire, with a very foul and bloody smell.

sentences.zh: 慶元二年六月辛未，黃岩縣大石自隕，雷雨甚至，山水瀵湧。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei in the sixth month of the second year of Qingyuan, a great stone fell by itself in Huangyan County; thunder and rain were extreme, and mountain and river waters surged and overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the sixth month in 1196, a great stone fell by itself in Huangyan County; thunder and rain were extreme, and mountain and river waters surged and overflowed.
